      { brand: "krueger", state: "WI", region: "Midwest", rep: "Delta-T Equipment Sales, LLC", addr: "", city: "Onalaska", zip: "54650", phone: "608-788-1804", email: "", web: "", lat: 43.878, lng: -91.231 },
      { brand: "krueger", state: "WI", region: "Midwest", rep: "Delta-T Equipment Sales, LLC", addr: "", city: "DePere", zip: "54115", phone: "920-347-9180", email: "", web: "", lat: 44.449, lng: -88.060 },
      { brand: "krueger", state: "WI", region: "Midwest", rep: "Forced Air Products Inc.", addr: "", city: "New Berlin", zip: "53151", phone: "262-782-2434", email: "", web: "http://www.forcedairproducts.com", lat: 42.974, lng: -88.107 },
      { brand: "krueger", state: "WI", region: "Midwest", rep: "HVA Products", addr: "PO Box 428", city: "Mequon", zip: "53092", phone: "262-242-9393", email: "", web: "http://www.hvaproducts.com", lat: 43.229, lng: -87.964 },
      { brand: "krueger", state: "WY", region: "West", rep: "LONG Building Technologies", addr: "", city: "Casper", zip: "82605", phone: "(307) 265-5997", email: "sbrooks@long.com", web: "http://www.long.com", lat: 42.866, lng: -106.313 },
    ];

    const ALL_REPS = [...TITUS_REPS, ...KRUEGER_REPS];

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════
       STATE
    ═══════════════════════════════════════ */
    let activeVertical = 'data_center';
    let activeYear = '2025';
    let activeRegion = 'ALL';
    let activeBrandFilter = 'ALL';
    let searchTerm = '';
    let stateLayer = null;
    let pinLayer = L.layerGroup();
    let heatVisible = true;
    let pinsVisible = true;
    let filteredReps = [];
    let brandToggles = { titus: true, krueger: true };

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════
       MAP INIT
    ═══════════════════════════════════════ */
    const map = L.map('map', { center: [38.5, -96], zoom: 4, zoomControl: false, attributionControl: false });
    L.control.zoom({ position: 'bottomright' }).addTo(map);
    L.tileLayer('https://{s}.basemaps.cartocdn.com/dark_matter_all/{z}/{x}/{y}{r}.png', { maxZoom: 19 }).addTo(map);

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════
       VERTICAL SIDEBAR
    ═══════════════════════════════════════ */
    function buildVerticalList() {
      const CAGRS = { data_center: '18.5%', healthcare: '7.4%', industrial: '12.1%', education: '5.2%', multifamily: '8.4%', office: '3.2%', hospitality: '6.1%', government: '6.1%' };
      const TAGS = { data_center: { t: 'hot', l: '🔥 HOT' }, healthcare: { t: 'cool', l: '+7.4%' }, industrial: { t: 'warm', l: '+12.1%' }, education: { t: 'cool', l: '+5.2%' }, multifamily: { t: 'cool', l: '+8.4%' }, office: { t: 'warm', l: 'Moderate' }, hospitality: { t: 'cool', l: '+6.1%' }, government: { t: 'cool', l: '+6.1%' } };
      document.getElementById('v-list').innerHTML = Object.entries(VERTICALS).map(([k, v]) => {
        const tg = TAGS[k];
        return `<button class="v-btn${k === activeVertical ? ' active' : ''}" data-v="${k}" onclick="setVertical(this,'${k}')">
      <div class="v-icon-box" style="background:${v.color}18">${v.icon}</div>
      <div class="v-info"><strong>${v.label}</strong><em>${v.sub} · CAGR ${CAGRS[k]}</em></div>
      <span class="v-tag ${tg.t}">${tg.l}</span>
    </button>`;
      }).join('');
    }

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════
       STATE HEATMAP LAYER
    ═══════════════════════════════════════ */
    async function loadStateLayer() {
      const resp = await fetch('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/us-atlas@3/states-10m.json');
      const us = await resp.json();
      const geo = topojson.feature(us, us.objects.states);
      stateLayer = L.geoJSON(geo, {
        style: stateStyle,
        onEachFeature: (feat, layer) => {
          layer.on({ mouseover: onStateHover, mousemove: onStateMove, mouseout: onStateOut, click: onStateClick });
        }
      });
      if (heatVisible) stateLayer.addTo(map);
    }
    function stateStyle(feat) {
      const code = FIPS[feat.id.toString().padStart(2, '0')];
      if (!code || !STATE_DATA[code]) return { fillColor: '#0b1220', fillOpacity: .7, color: '#192840', weight: .8 };
      return { fillColor: scoreColor(getScore(code, activeVertical, activeYear)), fillOpacity: .72, color: '#0a1828', weight: .6 };
    }
    function recolorStates() { if (stateLayer) stateLayer.setStyle(stateStyle) }

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════
       STATE HOVER / CLICK
    ═══════════════════════════════════════ */
    const mapTT = document.getElementById('map-tooltip');
    function onStateHover(e) {
      e.target.setStyle({ weight: 2, color: '#00c8f0', fillOpacity: .88 });
      e.target.bringToFront();
      const code = FIPS[e.target.feature.id.toString().padStart(2, '0')];
      if (!code || !STATE_DATA[code]) { mapTT.classList.remove('show'); return; }
      const s = STATE_DATA[code];
      const score = getScore(code, activeVertical, activeYear);
      const vol = Math.round(getVol(activeVertical, code) * YF[activeYear][activeVertical]);
      const topV = Object.keys(VERTICALS).reduce((a, b) => getScore(code, a, activeYear) > getScore(code, b, activeYear) ? a : b);
      const tCount = ALL_REPS.filter(r => r.state === code && r.brand === 'titus').length;
      const kCount = ALL_REPS.filter(r => r.state === code && r.brand === 'krueger').length;
      mapTT.innerHTML = `<div class="mtt-name">${s.name}</div>
    <div class="mtt-row"><span>${VERTICALS[activeVertical].icon} ${VERTICALS[activeVertical].label}</span><b>${score}/100</b></div>
    <div class="mtt-row"><span>Est. Volume</span><b>$${vol}M</b></div>
    <div class="mtt-row"><span>Top Vertical</span><b>${VERTICALS[topV].icon} ${VERTICALS[topV].label}</b></div>
    <div class="mtt-row"><span style="color:var(--titus)">● Titus</span><b style="color:var(--titus)">${tCount} loc${tCount !== 1 ? 's' : ''}</b></div>
    <div class="mtt-row"><span style="color:var(--krueger)">● Krueger</span><b style="color:var(--krueger)">${kCount} loc${kCount !== 1 ? 's' : ''}</b></div>
    <div class="mtt-hint">Click for full intelligence →</div>`;
      mapTT.classList.add('show');
    }
    function onStateMove(e) {
      const box = document.getElementById('map-wrap').getBoundingClientRect();
      let x = e.originalEvent.clientX - box.left + 14, y = e.originalEvent.clientY - box.top - 10;
      if (x + 200 > box.width) x = e.originalEvent.clientX - box.left - 200;
      mapTT.style.left = x + 'px'; mapTT.style.top = y + 'px';
    }
    function onStateOut(e) { if (stateLayer) stateLayer.resetStyle(e.target); mapTT.classList.remove('show'); }
    function onStateClick(e) {
      const code = FIPS[e.target.feature.id.toString().padStart(2, '0')];
      if (code && STATE_DATA[code]) openStateModal(code);
    }

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════
       REP PINS — brand-colored
    ═══════════════════════════════════════ */
    function mkIcon(brand, offsetLng = 0) {
      const c = BRAND_COLOR[brand];
      const glow = BRAND_GLOW[brand];
      const emoji = brand === 'titus' ? '◆' : '◇';
      return L.divIcon({
        className: '',
        html: `<div style="width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50% 50% 50% 4px;transform:rotate(-45deg);background:${c};border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.3);box-shadow:0 3px 12px ${glow};display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer;">
      <span style="transform:rotate(45deg);font-size:10px;line-height:1;color:rgba(0,0,0,.5)">${emoji}</span></div>`,
        iconSize: [26, 26], iconAnchor: [13, 26], popupAnchor: [0, -28]
      });
    }

    function popupHTML(r) {
      const c = BRAND_COLOR[r.brand];
      const bLabel = r.brand === 'titus' ? 'TITUS' : 'KRUEGER';
      const addr = [r.addr, r.city, r.state, r.zip].filter(Boolean).join(', ');
      return `<div class="pop-header">
    <div class="pop-brand-stripe" style="background:${c}"></div>
    <div class="pop-head-content">
      <div class="pop-rep" style="color:${c}">${r.rep}</div>
      <div class="pop-meta">
        <span class="pop-badge" style="background:${c}18;border:1px solid ${c}40;color:${c}">${bLabel}</span>
        <span class="pop-badge" style="background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--muted2)">${r.state} · ${r.region}</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="pop-div"></div>
  <div class="pop-body">
    ${addr ? `<div class="pop-row"><span class="pi">📍</span><span class="pa">${addr}</span></div>` : ''}
    ${r.phone ? `<div class="pop-row"><span class="pi">📞</span><a href="tel:${r.phone.replace(/\s/g, '')}">${r.phone}</a></div>` : ''}
    ${r.email ? `<div class="pop-row"><span class="pi">✉️</span><a href="mailto:${r.email}">${r.email}</a></div>` : ''}
    ${r.web ? `<div class="pop-row"><span class="pi">🌐</span><a href="${r.web.startsWith('http') ? r.web : 'http://' + r.web}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">${r.web.replace(/https?:\/\//, '').replace(/\\/g, '/')}</a></div>` : ''}
  </div>`;
    }

    function renderPins() {
      pinLayer.clearLayers();
      filteredReps = ALL_REPS.filter(r => {
        if (!brandToggles[r.brand]) return false;
        const matchBrand = activeBrandFilter === 'ALL' || r.brand === activeBrandFilter;
        const matchRegion = activeRegion === 'ALL' || r.region === activeRegion;
        const q = searchTerm.toLowerCase();
        const matchSearch = !q || r.rep.toLowerCase().includes(q) || r.city.toLowerCase().includes(q) || r.state.toLowerCase().includes(q);
        return matchBrand && matchRegion && matchSearch;
      });
      filteredReps.forEach((r, i) => {
        const m = L.marker([r.lat, r.lng], { icon: mkIcon(r.brand) });
        m.bindPopup(popupHTML(r), { className: 'timap-popup', maxWidth: 300 });
        m.on('popupopen', () => {
          document.querySelectorAll('.rep-card').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('hl'));
          const card = document.querySelector(`.rep-card[data-idx="${i}"]`);
          if (card) { card.classList.add('hl'); card.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest', behavior: 'smooth' }) }
        });
        pinLayer.addLayer(m);
      });
      renderRepList();
      updateStats();
    }

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════
       SIDEBAR REP LIST
    ═══════════════════════════════════════ */
    function renderRepList() {
      const el = document.getElementById('rep-list');
      if (!filteredReps.length) { el.innerHTML = '<div class="no-results">No reps found.<br>Adjust brand, region, or search.</div>'; return; }
      el.innerHTML = filteredReps.map((r, i) => {
        const c = BRAND_COLOR[r.brand];
        const bLabel = r.brand === 'titus' ? 'T' : 'K';
        return `<div class="rep-card" data-idx="${i}" onclick="flyToRep(${i},this)">
      <div class="rc-head">
        <span class="rc-brand-dot" style="background:${c};box-shadow:0 0 5px ${c}80"></span>
        <span class="rc-name">${r.rep}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="rc-sub">
        <span class="rc-state" style="background:${c}18;border:1px solid ${c}40;color:${c}">${r.state}</span>
        <span class="rc-city">${r.city}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="rc-dots">
        <span class="rc-dot ${r.phone ? 'on' : 'off'}">📞</span>
        <span class="rc-dot ${r.email ? 'on' : 'off'}">✉</span>
        <span class="rc-dot ${r.web ? 'on' : 'off'}">🌐</span>
        <span class="rc-dot on" style="background:${c}18;border-color:${c}40;color:${c}">${bLabel}</span>
      </div>
    </div>`;
      }).join('');
    }

    function flyToRep(idx, el) {
      const r = filteredReps[idx]; if (!r) return;
      map.flyTo([r.lat, r.lng], 11, { duration: .7 });
      document.querySelectorAll('.rep-card').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('hl'));
      el.classList.add('hl');
      const layers = pinLayer.getLayers();
      if (layers[idx]) setTimeout(() => layers[idx].openPopup(), 750);
    }

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════
       STATS
    ═══════════════════════════════════════ */
    function updateStats() {
      const tCount = filteredReps.filter(r => r.brand === 'titus').length;
      const kCount = filteredReps.filter(r => r.brand === 'krueger').length;
      document.getElementById('sp-total').textContent = filteredReps.length;
      document.getElementById('sp-titus').textContent = tCount;
      document.getElementById('sp-krueger').textContent = kCount;
      document.getElementById('foot-txt').textContent =
        `${filteredReps.length} total locations · ${tCount} Titus · ${kCount} Krueger · ${new Set(filteredReps.map(r => r.state)).size} states`;
    }

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════
       CONTROLS
    ═══════════════════════════════════════ */
    function setVertical(btn, v) { document.querySelectorAll('.v-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active')); btn.classList.add('active'); activeVertical = v; recolorStates() }
    function setYear(btn, yr) { document.querySelectorAll('.yr-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active')); btn.classList.add('active'); activeYear = yr; recolorStates() }
    function filterRegion(btn) { document.querySelectorAll('.rgn-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active')); btn.classList.add('active'); activeRegion = btn.dataset.region; renderPins() }
    function filterBrand(btn) { document.querySelectorAll('.fb-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active')); btn.classList.add('active'); activeBrandFilter = btn.dataset.brand; renderPins() }
    document.getElementById('rep-search').addEventListener('input', e => { searchTerm = e.target.value; renderPins() });
    function showTab(tab, btn) { document.querySelectorAll('.side-tab').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active')); document.querySelectorAll('.side-panel').forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active')); btn.classList.add('active'); document.getElementById('panel-' + tab).classList.add('active') }

    /* Brand header toggles (show/hide on map) */
    function toggleBrand(brand, btn) {
      brandToggles[brand] = !brandToggles[brand];
      btn.classList.toggle('off', !brandToggles[brand]);
      renderPins();
    }
    function toggleLayer(which, btn) {
      btn.classList.toggle('on');
      if (which === 'heat') { heatVisible = btn.classList.contains('on'); heatVisible && stateLayer ? stateLayer.addTo(map) : stateLayer && map.removeLayer(stateLayer) }
      else { pinsVisible = btn.classList.contains('on'); pinsVisible ? pinLayer.addTo(map) : map.removeLayer(pinLayer) }
    }

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════
       HVAC MODAL
    ═══════════════════════════════════════ */
    function openStateModal(code) {
      const s = STATE_DATA[code];
      document.getElementById('m-title').innerHTML = `${s.name} <span>${code}</span>`;
      document.getElementById('m-region').textContent = s.region;
      const score = getScore(code, activeVertical, activeYear);
      document.getElementById('m-idx').textContent = `${score}/100`;
      const yoy = Math.round((YF[activeYear][activeVertical] - 1) * 100);
      const yoyEl = document.getElementById('m-yoy');
      yoyEl.textContent = `+${yoy}% vs 2025`;
      yoyEl.style.color = yoy > 10 ? 'var(--green)' : yoy > 5 ? 'var(--amber)' : 'var(--text)';

      const topV = Object.keys(VERTICALS).reduce((a, b) => getScore(code, a, activeYear) > getScore(code, b, activeYear) ? a : b);
      const totalVol = Object.keys(VERTICALS).reduce((s, v) => s + Math.round(getVol(v, code) * YF[activeYear][v]), 0);
      const avgScore = Math.round(Object.keys(VERTICALS).reduce((s, v) => s + getScore(code, v, activeYear), 0) / Object.keys(VERTICALS).length);
      const fcYears = ['2025', '2026', '2027', '2028'];
      const fcScores = fcYears.map(y => getScore(code, activeVertical, y));
      const fcMax = Math.max(...fcScores, 1);
      const vColor = VERTICALS[activeVertical].color;
      const vGrad = VERTICALS[activeVertical].grad;
      const drivers = getDrivers(code, activeVertical);

      // Reps by brand for this state
      const titusHere = ALL_REPS.filter(r => r.state === code && r.brand === 'titus');
      const kruegerHere = ALL_REPS.filter(r => r.state === code && r.brand === 'krueger');
      const tFirms = [...new Set(titusHere.map(r => r.rep))];
      const kFirms = [...new Set(kruegerHere.map(r => r.rep))];

      function repBrandSection(reps, firms, brand) {
        if (!firms.length) return `<div style="font-family:var(--font-m);font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);padding:6px 0">No ${brand} locations in this state.</div>`;
        return firms.map(firm => {
          const locs = reps.filter(r => r.rep === firm);
          return `<div style="margin-bottom:8px">
        <div class="brand-rep-name" style="color:${BRAND_COLOR[brand]}">${firm}</div>
        ${locs.map(r => `<div class="brand-rep-loc">
          ${[r.addr, r.city].filter(Boolean).length ? `<span>📍 ${[r.addr, r.city].filter(Boolean).join(', ')}</span>` : '<span>📍 ' + r.city + '</span>'}
          ${r.phone ? `<span>📞 ${r.phone}</span>` : ''}
          ${r.email ? `<a href="mailto:${r.email}" style="color:var(--accent)">✉ ${r.email}</a>` : ''}
        </div>`).join('')}
      </div>`;
        }).join('');
      }

      document.getElementById('modal-body').innerHTML = `
    <div>
      <div class="m-sec">Market Overview ${activeYear}</div>
      <div class="m-ov">
        <div class="m-ov-card"><div class="lbl">Composite Index</div><div class="val">${avgScore}</div><div class="sub">/ 100 all verticals</div></div>
        <div class="m-ov-card"><div class="lbl">Est. Total Volume</div><div class="val">$${(totalVol / 1000).toFixed(1)}B</div><div class="sub">all verticals · ${activeYear}</div></div>
        <div class="m-ov-card"><div class="lbl">Top Vertical</div><div class="val" style="font-size:14px;margin-top:3px">${VERTICALS[topV].icon} ${VERTICALS[topV].label}</div><div class="sub">score: ${getScore(code, topV, activeYear)}/100</div></div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div>
      <div class="m-sec">All Verticals · ${activeYear}</div>
      ${Object.entries(VERTICALS).map(([k, v], i) => {
        const sc = getScore(code, k, activeYear);
        const volM = Math.round(getVol(k, code) * YF[activeYear][k]);
        const trend = sc >= 80 ? '🔥 Peak' : sc >= 60 ? '⬆ High' : sc >= 40 ? '→ Moderate' : '⬇ Low';
        return `<div class="vr-row" style="animation-delay:${i * .04}s">
          <div class="vr-head"><span class="vr-icon">${v.icon}</span><span class="vr-name">${v.label}</span><span class="vr-score" style="color:${v.color}">${sc}</span></div>
          <div class="vr-bar-bg"><div class="vr-bar-fill" style="width:${sc}%;background:${v.grad}"></div></div>
          <div class="vr-detail"><span>Vol: <b>$${volM}M</b></span><span>Trend: <b>${trend}</b></span><span>CAGR: <b>${getCAGR(k)}%</b></span></div>
        </div>`;
      }).join('')}
    </div>
    <div>
      <div class="m-sec">${VERTICALS[activeVertical].icon} ${VERTICALS[activeVertical].label} · 4-Year Forecast</div>
      <div class="fc-wrap">
        <div class="fc-bars">
          ${fcYears.map((y, i) => { const sc = fcScores[i]; const h = Math.round((sc / fcMax) * 72); const isA = y === activeYear; return `<div class="fc-col"><div class="fc-v" style="color:${vColor}">${sc}</div><div class="fc-outer" style="height:${h}px;background:${isA ? vColor + '22' : 'var(--border)'}"><div class="fc-fill" style="height:${h}px;background:${vGrad};opacity:${isA ? 1 : .45}"></div></div><div class="fc-yr" style="${isA ? 'color:' + vColor : ''}">${y}</div></div>` }).join('')}
        </div>
        <div class="tag-row">${drivers.map(d => `<span class="tag ${d.t}">${d.l}</span>`).join('')}</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div>
      <div class="m-sec">Rep Coverage in ${s.name}</div>
      <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px">
        <div class="brand-rep-section titus">
          <div class="brand-rep-heading"><span class="brand-badge titus">TITUS</span>${titusHere.length} location${titusHere.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}</div>
          <div class="brand-rep-locs">${repBrandSection(titusHere, tFirms, 'titus')}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="brand-rep-section krueger">
          <div class="brand-rep-heading"><span class="brand-badge krueger">KRUEGER</span>${kruegerHere.length} location${kruegerHere.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}</div>
          <div class="brand-rep-locs">${repBrandSection(kruegerHere, kFirms, 'krueger')}</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  `;
      document.getElementById('modal-overlay').classList.add('open');
    }

    function closeModal(e) { if (e && e.target !== document.getElementById('modal-overlay')) return; document.getElementById('modal-overlay').classList.remove('open') }
    document.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.key === 'Escape') document.getElementById('modal-overlay').classList.remove('open') });

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════
       BOOT
    ═══════════════════════════════════════ */
    buildVerticalList();
    loadStateLayer().catch(console.error);
    pinLayer.addTo(map);
    renderPins();

  </script>
</body>

</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">

<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow, noarchive, nosnippet" />
  <meta name="googlebot" content="noindex, nofollow" />
  <title>Triune Atlas — Market Intelligence & Rep Network</title>

  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com" />
  <link
    href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Syne:wght@600;700;800&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500;600&family=DM+Sans:wght@300;400;500;600&display=swap"
    rel="stylesheet" />
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/leaflet/1.9.4/leaflet.min.css" />
  <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/leaflet/1.9.4/leaflet.min.js"></script>
  <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/topojson/3.0.2/topojson.min.js"></script>

  <style>
    *,
    *::before,
    *::after {
      box-sizing: border-box;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0
    }

    :root {
      --bg: #06090f;
      --surface: #0b1220;
      --surface2: #101a2c;
      --surface3: #162036;
      --border: #192840;
      --border2: #1f3150;
      --text: #dce8f8;
      --muted: #4f6680;
      --muted2: #7090b0;
      --accent: #00c8f0;
      --accent-dim: rgba(0, 200, 240, .1);
      --titus: #00c8f0;
      --titus-dim: rgba(0, 200, 240, .12);
      --titus-glow: rgba(0, 200, 240, .5);
      --krueger: #ff7020;
      --krueger-dim: rgba(255, 112, 32, .12);
      --krueger-glow: rgba(255, 112, 32, .5);
      --green: #00f090;
      --amber: #ffa020;
      --red: #ff3c50;
      --font-d: 'Syne', sans-serif;
      --font-m: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace;
      --font-b: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
      --sidebar: 300px;
      --header: 56px;
      --footer: 30px;
    }

    html,
    body {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      background: var(--bg);
      color: var(--text);
      font-family: var(--font-b);
      overflow: hidden;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0
    }

    /* ══ LAYOUT ══ */
    #app {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-rows: var(--header) 1fr var(--footer);
      grid-template-columns: var(--sidebar) 1fr;
      grid-template-areas: "hdr hdr" "side map" "foot foot";
      width: 100%;
      height: 100vh;
      min-height: 600px
    }

    /* ══ HEADER ══ */
    #hdr {
      grid-area: hdr;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      padding: 0 16px;
      background: var(--surface);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      z-index: 500;
      position: relative
    }

    #hdr::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      height: 1px;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--titus), var(--krueger), transparent);
      opacity: .5
    }

    .logo-wrap {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 9px;
      flex-shrink: 0
    }

    .logo-hex {
      width: 26px;
      height: 26px;
      clip-path: polygon(50% 0%, 100% 25%, 100% 75%, 50% 100%, 0% 75%, 0% 25%);
      animation: pulse-hex 3s ease-in-out infinite
    }

    @keyframes pulse-hex {

      0%,
      100% {
        background: var(--titus);
        filter: drop-shadow(0 0 5px var(--titus))
      }

      50% {
        background: var(--krueger);
        filter: drop-shadow(0 0 12px var(--krueger))
      }
    }

    .logo-text {
      font-family: var(--font-d);
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: .06em
    }

    .logo-text .t {
      color: var(--titus)
    }

    .logo-text .k {
      color: var(--krueger)
    }

    .logo-text .sep {
      color: var(--muted)
    }

    .hdr-div {
      width: 1px;
      height: 26px;
      background: var(--border2);
      flex-shrink: 0
    }

    /* Brand legend pills */
    .brand-legend {
      display: flex;
      gap: 6px;
      align-items: center
    }

    .brand-pill {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 5px;
      padding: 4px 10px;
      border-radius: 20px;
      font-family: var(--font-m);
      font-size: 10px;
      border: 1px solid;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all .2s;
      letter-spacing: .02em
    }

    .brand-pill .bdot {
      width: 8px;
      height: 8px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      transition: all .2s
    }

    .brand-pill.titus {
      border-color: rgba(0, 200, 240, .3);
      color: var(--titus);
      background: var(--titus-dim)
    }

    .brand-pill.titus .bdot {
      background: var(--titus);
      box-shadow: 0 0 6px var(--titus)
    }

    .brand-pill.krueger {
      border-color: rgba(255, 112, 32, .3);
      color: var(--krueger);
      background: var(--krueger-dim)
    }

    .brand-pill.krueger .bdot {
      background: var(--krueger);
      box-shadow: 0 0 6px var(--krueger)
    }

    .brand-pill.off {
      opacity: .35;
      filter: grayscale(.8)
    }

    /* Layer toggles */
    .layer-toggles {
      display: flex;
      gap: 5px;
      align-items: center
    }

    .layer-toggle {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 5px;
      padding: 4px 9px;
      border-radius: 5px;
      border: 1px solid var(--border2);
      background: none;
      color: var(--muted2);
      cursor: pointer;
      font-family: var(--font-m);
      font-size: 10px;
      transition: all .2s
    }

    .layer-toggle .dot {
      width: 6px;
      height: 6px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--muted);
      transition: all .2s
    }

    .layer-toggle.on {
      background: var(--accent-dim);
      border-color: var(--accent);
      color: var(--accent)
    }

    .layer-toggle.on .dot {
      background: var(--accent);
      box-shadow: 0 0 5px var(--accent)
    }

    /* Stats */
    .hdr-stats {
      margin-left: auto;
      display: flex;
      gap: 6px;
      align-items: center
    }

    .stat-pill {
      background: var(--surface2);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      font-family: var(--font-m);
      font-size: 10px;
      padding: 4px 10px;
      border-radius: 4px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 1px;
      align-items: flex-end
    }

    .stat-pill b {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--text)
    }

    .stat-pill span {
      font-size: 9px;
      color: var(--muted);
      letter-spacing: .04em
    }

    .live-dot {
      width: 6px;
      height: 6px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--green);
      display: inline-block;
      margin-right: 4px;
      animation: blink 2s step-end infinite;
      vertical-align: middle
    }

    @keyframes blink {

      0%,
      100% {
        opacity: 1
      }

      50% {
        opacity: .15
      }
    }

    /* ══ SIDEBAR ══ */
    #side {
      grid-area: side;
      background: var(--surface);
      border-right: 1px solid var(--border);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      overflow: hidden;
      z-index: 400
    }

    .side-tabs {
      display: flex;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      flex-shrink: 0
    }

    .side-tab {
      flex: 1;
      padding: 10px 5px;
      text-align: center;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-family: var(--font-m);
      font-size: 10px;
      letter-spacing: .04em;
      color: var(--muted);
      border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;
      transition: all .2s;
      background: none;
      border-top: none;
      border-left: none;
      border-right: none
    }

    .side-tab:hover {
      color: var(--text)
    }

    .side-tab.active {
      color: var(--accent);
      border-bottom-color: var(--accent);
      background: var(--accent-dim)
    }

    .side-panel {
      flex: 1;
      overflow: hidden;
      display: none;
      flex-direction: column
    }

    .side-panel.active {
      display: flex
    }

    /* Market panel */
    .sec-label {
      font-family: var(--font-m);
      font-size: 9px;
      letter-spacing: .12em;
      color: var(--muted);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      padding: 10px 14px 6px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      flex-shrink: 0
    }

    .verticals-list {
      overflow-y: auto;
      flex: 1
    }

    .verticals-list::-webkit-scrollbar {
      width: 3px
    }

    .verticals-list::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
      background: var(--border)
    }

    .v-btn {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 9px;
      width: 100%;
      padding: 9px 14px;
      background: none;
      border: none;
      border-left: 3px solid transparent;
      cursor: pointer;
      text-align: left;
      transition: all .18s
    }

    .v-btn:hover {
      background: rgba(0, 200, 240, .04)
    }

    .v-btn.active {
      background: rgba(0, 200, 240, .07);
      border-left-color: var(--accent)
    }

    .v-icon-box {
      width: 26px;
      height: 26px;
      border-radius: 5px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 13px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      transition: transform .18s
    }

    .v-btn:hover .v-icon-box {
      transform: scale(1.1)
    }

    .v-info {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 1px;
      flex: 1
    }

    .v-info strong {
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--text)
    }

    .v-info em {
      font-family: var(--font-m);
      font-size: 9px;
      color: var(--green);
      font-style: normal
    }

    .v-tag {
      margin-left: auto;
      font-family: var(--font-m);
      font-size: 9px;
      font-weight: 600;
      padding: 2px 6px;
      border-radius: 3px
    }

    .v-tag.hot {
      background: rgba(255, 60, 80, .12);
      color: var(--red)
    }

    .v-tag.warm {
      background: rgba(255, 160, 32, .12);
      color: var(--amber)
    }

    .v-tag.cool {
      background: rgba(0, 240, 144, .1);
      color: var(--green)
    }

    .year-block {
      flex-shrink: 0;
      padding: 10px 14px;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border)
    }

    .year-btns {
      display: flex;
      gap: 5px;
      margin-top: 7px
    }

    .yr-btn {
      flex: 1;
      padding: 5px 3px;
      background: var(--bg);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      color: var(--muted);
      border-radius: 4px;
      font-family: var(--font-m);
      font-size: 10px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all .15s;
      text-align: center
    }

    .yr-btn:hover {
      border-color: var(--accent);
      color: var(--accent)
    }

    .yr-btn.active {
      background: var(--accent-dim);
      border-color: var(--accent);
      color: var(--accent)
    }

    .legend-block {
      flex-shrink: 0;
      padding: 10px 14px;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border)
    }

    .legend-bar {
      height: 7px;
      border-radius: 4px;
      background: linear-gradient(to right, #0a1828, #0b3d6b, #0e82cc, #00c8f0, #60e8ff);
      margin: 7px 0 5px
    }

    .legend-labs {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      font-family: var(--font-m);
      font-size: 9px;
      color: var(--muted)
    }

    /* Rep panel */
    .rep-search-wrap {
      padding: 10px 14px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      flex-shrink: 0
    }

    .search-inner {
      position: relative
    }

    .search-inner input {
      width: 100%;
      background: var(--bg);
      border: 1px solid var(--border2);
      border-radius: 6px;
      padding: 8px 10px 8px 30px;
      color: var(--text);
      font-family: var(--font-b);
      font-size: 12px;
      outline: none;
      transition: border-color .15s
    }

    .search-inner input:focus {
      border-color: var(--accent)
    }

    .search-inner input::placeholder {
      color: var(--muted)
    }

    .search-icon-abs {
      position: absolute;
      left: 9px;
      top: 50%;
      transform: translateY(-50%);
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 12px;
      pointer-events: none
    }

    /* Brand + region filters */
    .rep-filters {
      padding: 8px 14px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 6px;
      flex-shrink: 0
    }

    .filter-row {
      display: flex;
      gap: 4px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      align-items: center
    }

    .filter-row-label {
      font-family: var(--font-m);
      font-size: 9px;
      color: var(--muted);
      letter-spacing: .08em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      width: 100%
    }

    .fb-btn {
      background: var(--bg);
      border: 1px solid;
      font-family: var(--font-m);
      font-size: 9px;
      padding: 3px 8px;
      border-radius: 3px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all .15s;
      font-weight: 600
    }

    .fb-btn.titus {
      border-color: rgba(0, 200, 240, .4);
      color: var(--titus)
    }

    .fb-btn.titus.active {
      background: var(--titus-dim);
      border-color: var(--titus)
    }

    .fb-btn.krueger {
      border-color: rgba(255, 112, 32, .4);
      color: var(--krueger)
    }

    .fb-btn.krueger.active {
      background: var(--krueger-dim);
      border-color: var(--krueger)
    }

    .fb-btn.both {
      border-color: var(--border2);
      color: var(--muted2)
    }

    .fb-btn.both.active {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .05);
      border-color: var(--muted2);
      color: var(--text)
    }

    .rgn-btn {
      background: var(--bg);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      color: var(--muted);
      font-family: var(--font-m);
      font-size: 9px;
      padding: 3px 7px;
      border-radius: 3px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all .15s
    }

    .rgn-btn:hover {
      border-color: var(--accent);
      color: var(--accent)
    }

    .rgn-btn.active {
      background: var(--accent-dim);
      border-color: var(--accent);
      color: var(--accent)
    }

    #rep-list {
      overflow-y: auto;
      flex: 1
    }

    #rep-list::-webkit-scrollbar {
      width: 3px
    }

    #rep-list::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
      background: var(--border)
    }

    .rep-card {
      padding: 9px 14px;
      border-left: 3px solid transparent;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all .15s;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(25, 40, 64, .6)
    }

    .rep-card:hover {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .03)
    }

    .rep-card.hl {
      background: rgba(0, 200, 240, .06);
      border-left-color: var(--accent)
    }

    .rc-head {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 6px;
      margin-bottom: 2px
    }

    .rc-brand-dot {
      width: 8px;
      height: 8px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      margin-top: 3px
    }

    .rc-name {
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--text);
      line-height: 1.3
    }

    .rc-sub {
      display: flex;
      gap: 6px;
      align-items: center;
      margin-top: 2px
    }

    .rc-state {
      font-family: var(--font-m);
      font-size: 9px;
      font-weight: 600;
      padding: 1px 5px;
      border-radius: 2px
    }

    .rc-city {
      font-family: var(--font-m);
      font-size: 10px;
      color: var(--muted2)
    }

    .rc-dots {
      display: flex;
      gap: 5px;
      margin-top: 4px
    }

    .rc-dot {
      font-size: 9px;
      padding: 2px 6px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      font-family: var(--font-m)
    }

    .rc-dot.on {
      background: rgba(0, 240, 144, .1);
      color: var(--green);
      border: 1px solid rgba(0, 240, 144, .2)
    }

    .rc-dot.off {
      background: rgba(79, 102, 128, .08);
      color: var(--muted);
      border: 1px solid var(--border)
    }

    .no-results {
      padding: 24px 14px;
      text-align: center;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 11px;
      font-family: var(--font-m);
      line-height: 1.6
    }

    /* ══ MAP ══ */
    #map-wrap {
      grid-area: map;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1
    }

    #map {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%
    }

    .leaflet-container {
      background: var(--bg) !important
    }

    .leaflet-tile-pane {
      filter: brightness(.7) saturate(.5) hue-rotate(180deg)
    }

    .leaflet-control-zoom a {
      background: var(--surface) !important;
      color: var(--text) !important;
      border-color: var(--border) !important
    }

    .leaflet-control-zoom a:hover {
      background: var(--surface2) !important
    }

    #map-tooltip {
      position: absolute;
      pointer-events: none;
      z-index: 800;
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border2);
      border-radius: 8px;
      padding: 10px 14px;
      min-width: 180px;
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity .12s;
      box-shadow: 0 8px 28px rgba(0, 0, 0, .7)
    }

    #map-tooltip.show {
      opacity: 1
    }

    .mtt-name {
      font-family: var(--font-d);
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 700;
      margin-bottom: 5px
    }

    .mtt-row {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 16px;
      font-size: 10px;
      color: var(--muted2);
      margin-top: 3px
    }

    .mtt-row b {
      font-family: var(--font-m);
      color: var(--accent);
      font-size: 11px
    }

    .mtt-hint {
      margin-top: 7px;
      font-family: var(--font-m);
      font-size: 9px;
      color: var(--muted);
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
      padding-top: 6px;
      letter-spacing: .04em
    }

    .map-credit {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 8px;
      left: 8px;
      z-index: 700;
      font-family: var(--font-m);
      font-size: 9px;
      color: var(--muted);
      background: rgba(6, 9, 15, .78);
      padding: 5px 9px;
      border-radius: 4px;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      pointer-events: none;
      backdrop-filter: blur(4px)
    }

    /* ══ FOOTER ══ */
    #foot {
      grid-area: foot;
      background: var(--surface);
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 14px;
      padding: 0 16px;
      font-family: var(--font-m);
      font-size: 9px;
      color: var(--muted)
    }

    #foot .sep {
      color: var(--border2)
    }

    /* ══ LEAFLET POPUP ══ */
    .timap-popup .leaflet-popup-content-wrapper {
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border2);
      border-radius: 10px;
      box-shadow: 0 16px 48px rgba(0, 0, 0, .85);
      padding: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      min-width: 260px;
      max-width: 300px
    }

    .timap-popup .leaflet-popup-tip {
      background: var(--surface)
    }

    .timap-popup .leaflet-popup-content {
      margin: 0;
      width: auto !important
    }

    .pop-header {
      padding: 12px 16px 10px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 10px
    }

    .pop-brand-stripe {
      width: 4px;
      border-radius: 2px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      align-self: stretch;
      min-height: 36px
    }

    .pop-head-content {
      flex: 1
    }

    .pop-rep {
      font-family: var(--font-d);
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 700;
      margin-bottom: 3px
    }

    .pop-meta {
      display: flex;
      gap: 5px;
      align-items: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap
    }

    .pop-badge {
      font-family: var(--font-m);
      font-size: 8px;
      padding: 2px 6px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      letter-spacing: .08em;
      font-weight: 600
    }

    .pop-div {
      height: 1px;
      background: var(--border);
      margin: 0 16px
    }

    .pop-body {
      padding: 8px 16px 12px
    }

    .pop-row {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      align-items: flex-start;
      margin-top: 6px;
      font-size: 11px;
      color: var(--muted2);
      line-height: 1.5
    }

    .pop-row .pi {
      font-size: 12px;
      flex-shrink: 0
    }

    .pop-row a {
      color: var(--accent);
      text-decoration: none;
      word-break: break-all
    }

    .pop-row a:hover {
      text-decoration: underline
    }

    .pop-row .pa {
      color: var(--text);
      font-size: 11px
    }

    /* ══ HVAC MODAL ══ */
    #modal-overlay {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: 2000;

      opacity: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      transition: opacity .22s
    }

      opacity: 1;
      pointer-events: all
    }

      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      box-shadow: 0 32px 80px rgba(0, 0, 0, .9);
      transform: translateY(18px) scale(.98);
      transition: transform .22s
    }

      transform: none
    }

    #modal-hdr {
      padding: 20px 24px 16px;

      align-items: flex-start;
      justify-content: space-between;
      flex-shrink: 0

      font-family: var(--font-d);
      font-size: 25px;
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1
    }

    .m-state-name span {
      color: var(--accent)
    }

    .m-meta {
      font-family: var(--font-m);
      font-size: 10px;
      color: var(--muted);
      margin-top: 6px;
      display: flex;
      gap: 14px
    }

    .m-meta b {
      color: var(--text)
    }

    .m-close {
      background: none;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      color: var(--muted);
      width: 28px;
      height: 28px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-size: 14px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      transition: all .15s;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      margin-top: 2px
    }

    .m-close:hover {
      border-color: var(--red);
      color: var(--red)
    }

    #modal-body {
      overflow-y: auto;
      padding: 18px 24px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 18px
    }

    #modal-body::-webkit-scrollbar {
      width: 3px
    }

    #modal-body::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
      background: var(--border)
    }

    .m-sec {
      font-family: var(--font-m);
      font-size: 9px;
      letter-spacing: .12em;
      color: var(--muted);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-bottom: 6px
    }

    .m-sec::after {
      content: '';
      flex: 1;
      height: 1px;
      background: var(--border)
    }

    .m-ov {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 10px

      background: var(--bg);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);

      { brand: "krueger", state: "WI", region: "Midwest", rep: "Delta-T Equipment Sales, LLC", addr: "", city: "DePere", zip: "54115", phone: "920-347-9180", email: "", web: "", lat: 44.449, lng: -88.060 },
      { brand: "krueger", state: "WI", region: "Midwest", rep: "Forced Air Products Inc.", addr: "", city: "New Berlin", zip: "53151", phone: "262-782-2434", email: "", web: "http://www.forcedairproducts.com", lat: 42.974, lng: -88.107 },
      { brand: "krueger", state: "WI", region: "Midwest", rep: "HVA Products", addr: "PO Box 428", city: "Mequon", zip: "53092", phone: "262-242-9393", email: "", web: "http://www.hvaproducts.com", lat: 43.229, lng: -87.964 },
      { brand: "krueger", state: "WY", region: "West", rep: "LONG Building Technologies", addr: "", city: "Casper", zip: "82605", phone: "(307) 265-5997", email: "sbrooks@long.com", web: "http://www.long.com", lat: 42.866, lng: -106.313 },
    ];

    const ALL_REPS = [...TITUS_REPS, ...KRUEGER_REPS];

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════
       STATE
    ═══════════════════════════════════════ */
    let activeVertical = 'data_center';
    let activeYear = '2025';
    let activeRegion = 'ALL';
    let activeBrandFilter = 'ALL';
    let searchTerm = '';
    let stateLayer = null;
    let pinLayer = L.layerGroup();
    let heatVisible = true;
    let pinsVisible = true;
    let filteredReps = [];
    let brandToggles = { titus: true, krueger: true };

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════
       MAP INIT
    ═══════════════════════════════════════ */
    const map = L.map('map', { center: [38.5, -96], zoom: 4, zoomControl: false, attributionControl: false });
    L.control.zoom({ position: 'bottomright' }).addTo(map);
    L.tileLayer('https://{s}.basemaps.cartocdn.com/dark_matter_all/{z}/{x}/{y}{r}.png', { maxZoom: 19 }).addTo(map);

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════
       VERTICAL SIDEBAR
    ═══════════════════════════════════════ */
    function buildVerticalList() {
      const CAGRS = { data_center: '18.5%', healthcare: '7.4%', industrial: '12.1%', education: '5.2%', multifamily: '8.4%', office: '3.2%', hospitality: '6.1%', government: '6.1%' };
      const TAGS = { data_center: { t: 'hot', l: '🔥 HOT' }, healthcare: { t: 'cool', l: '+7.4%' }, industrial: { t: 'warm', l: '+12.1%' }, education: { t: 'cool', l: '+5.2%' }, multifamily: { t: 'cool', l: '+8.4%' }, office: { t: 'warm', l: 'Moderate' }, hospitality: { t: 'cool', l: '+6.1%' }, government: { t: 'cool', l: '+6.1%' } };
      document.getElementById('v-list').innerHTML = Object.entries(VERTICALS).map(([k, v]) => {
        const tg = TAGS[k];
        return `<button class="v-btn${k === activeVertical ? ' active' : ''}" data-v="${k}" onclick="setVertical(this,'${k}')">
      <div class="v-icon-box" style="background:${v.color}18">${v.icon}</div>
      <div class="v-info"><strong>${v.label}</strong><em>${v.sub} · CAGR ${CAGRS[k]}</em></div>
      <span class="v-tag ${tg.t}">${tg.l}</span>
    </button>`;
      }).join('');
    }

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════
       STATE HEATMAP LAYER
    ═══════════════════════════════════════ */
    async function loadStateLayer() {
      const resp = await fetch('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/us-atlas@3/states-10m.json');
      const us = await resp.json();
      const geo = topojson.feature(us, us.objects.states);
      stateLayer = L.geoJSON(geo, {
        style: stateStyle,
        onEachFeature: (feat, layer) => {
          layer.on({ mouseover: onStateHover, mousemove: onStateMove, mouseout: onStateOut, click: onStateClick });
        }
      });
      if (heatVisible) stateLayer.addTo(map);
    }
    function stateStyle(feat) {
      const code = FIPS[feat.id.toString().padStart(2, '0')];
      if (!code || !STATE_DATA[code]) return { fillColor: '#0b1220', fillOpacity: .7, color: '#192840', weight: .8 };
      return { fillColor: scoreColor(getScore(code, activeVertical, activeYear)), fillOpacity: .72, color: '#0a1828', weight: .6 };
    }
    function recolorStates() { if (stateLayer) stateLayer.setStyle(stateStyle) }

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════
       STATE HOVER / CLICK
    ═══════════════════════════════════════ */
    const mapTT = document.getElementById('map-tooltip');
    function onStateHover(e) {
      e.target.setStyle({ weight: 2, color: '#00c8f0', fillOpacity: .88 });
      e.target.bringToFront();
      const code = FIPS[e.target.feature.id.toString().padStart(2, '0')];
      if (!code || !STATE_DATA[code]) { mapTT.classList.remove('show'); return; }
      const s = STATE_DATA[code];
      const score = getScore(code, activeVertical, activeYear);
      const vol = Math.round(getVol(activeVertical, code) * YF[activeYear][activeVertical]);
      const topV = Object.keys(VERTICALS).reduce((a, b) => getScore(code, a, activeYear) > getScore(code, b, activeYear) ? a : b);
      const tCount = ALL_REPS.filter(r => r.state === code && r.brand === 'titus').length;
      const kCount = ALL_REPS.filter(r => r.state === code && r.brand === 'krueger').length;
      mapTT.innerHTML = `<div class="mtt-name">${s.name}</div>
    <div class="mtt-row"><span>${VERTICALS[activeVertical].icon} ${VERTICALS[activeVertical].label}</span><b>${score}/100</b></div>
    <div class="mtt-row"><span>Est. Volume</span><b>$${vol}M</b></div>
    <div class="mtt-row"><span>Top Vertical</span><b>${VERTICALS[topV].icon} ${VERTICALS[topV].label}</b></div>
    <div class="mtt-row"><span style="color:var(--titus)">● Titus</span><b style="color:var(--titus)">${tCount} loc${tCount !== 1 ? 's' : ''}</b></div>
    <div class="mtt-row"><span style="color:var(--krueger)">● Krueger</span><b style="color:var(--krueger)">${kCount} loc${kCount !== 1 ? 's' : ''}</b></div>
    <div class="mtt-hint">Click for full intelligence →</div>`;
      mapTT.classList.add('show');
    }
    function onStateMove(e) {
      const box = document.getElementById('map-wrap').getBoundingClientRect();
      let x = e.originalEvent.clientX - box.left + 14, y = e.originalEvent.clientY - box.top - 10;
      if (x + 200 > box.width) x = e.originalEvent.clientX - box.left - 200;
      mapTT.style.left = x + 'px'; mapTT.style.top = y + 'px';
    }
    function onStateOut(e) { if (stateLayer) stateLayer.resetStyle(e.target); mapTT.classList.remove('show'); }
    function onStateClick(e) {
      const code = FIPS[e.target.feature.id.toString().padStart(2, '0')];
      if (code && STATE_DATA[code]) openStateModal(code);
    }

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════
       REP PINS — brand-colored
    ═══════════════════════════════════════ */
    function mkIcon(brand, offsetLng = 0) {
      const c = BRAND_COLOR[brand];
      const glow = BRAND_GLOW[brand];
      const emoji = brand === 'titus' ? '◆' : '◇';
      return L.divIcon({
        className: '',
        html: `<div style="width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50% 50% 50% 4px;transform:rotate(-45deg);background:${c};border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.3);box-shadow:0 3px 12px ${glow};display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer;">
      <span style="transform:rotate(45deg);font-size:10px;line-height:1;color:rgba(0,0,0,.5)">${emoji}</span></div>`,
        iconSize: [26, 26], iconAnchor: [13, 26], popupAnchor: [0, -28]
      });
    }

    function popupHTML(r) {
      const c = BRAND_COLOR[r.brand];
      const bLabel = r.brand === 'titus' ? 'TITUS' : 'KRUEGER';
      const addr = [r.addr, r.city, r.state, r.zip].filter(Boolean).join(', ');
      return `<div class="pop-header">
    <div class="pop-brand-stripe" style="background:${c}"></div>
    <div class="pop-head-content">
      <div class="pop-rep" style="color:${c}">${r.rep}</div>
      <div class="pop-meta">
        <span class="pop-badge" style="background:${c}18;border:1px solid ${c}40;color:${c}">${bLabel}</span>
        <span class="pop-badge" style="background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--muted2)">${r.state} · ${r.region}</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="pop-div"></div>
  <div class="pop-body">
    ${addr ? `<div class="pop-row"><span class="pi">📍</span><span class="pa">${addr}</span></div>` : ''}
    ${r.phone ? `<div class="pop-row"><span class="pi">📞</span><a href="tel:${r.phone.replace(/\s/g, '')}">${r.phone}</a></div>` : ''}
    ${r.email ? `<div class="pop-row"><span class="pi">✉️</span><a href="mailto:${r.email}">${r.email}</a></div>` : ''}
    ${r.web ? `<div class="pop-row"><span class="pi">🌐</span><a href="${r.web.startsWith('http') ? r.web : 'http://' + r.web}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">${r.web.replace(/https?:\/\//, '').replace(/\\/g, '/')}</a></div>` : ''}
  </div>`;
    }

    function renderPins() {
      pinLayer.clearLayers();
      filteredReps = ALL_REPS.filter(r => {
        if (!brandToggles[r.brand]) return false;
        const matchBrand = activeBrandFilter === 'ALL' || r.brand === activeBrandFilter;
        const matchRegion = activeRegion === 'ALL' || r.region === activeRegion;
        const q = searchTerm.toLowerCase();
        const matchSearch = !q || r.rep.toLowerCase().includes(q) || r.city.toLowerCase().includes(q) || r.state.toLowerCase().includes(q);
        return matchBrand && matchRegion && matchSearch;
      });
      filteredReps.forEach((r, i) => {
        const m = L.marker([r.lat, r.lng], { icon: mkIcon(r.brand) });
        m.bindPopup(popupHTML(r), { className: 'timap-popup', maxWidth: 300 });
        m.on('popupopen', () => {
          document.querySelectorAll('.rep-card').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('hl'));
          const card = document.querySelector(`.rep-card[data-idx="${i}"]`);
          if (card) { card.classList.add('hl'); card.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest', behavior: 'smooth' }) }
        });
        pinLayer.addLayer(m);
      });
      renderRepList();
      updateStats();
    }

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════
       SIDEBAR REP LIST
    ═══════════════════════════════════════ */
    function renderRepList() {
      const el = document.getElementById('rep-list');
      if (!filteredReps.length) { el.innerHTML = '<div class="no-results">No reps found.<br>Adjust brand, region, or search.</div>'; return; }
      el.innerHTML = filteredReps.map((r, i) => {
        const c = BRAND_COLOR[r.brand];
        const bLabel = r.brand === 'titus' ? 'T' : 'K';
        return `<div class="rep-card" data-idx="${i}" onclick="flyToRep(${i},this)">
      <div class="rc-head">
        <span class="rc-brand-dot" style="background:${c};box-shadow:0 0 5px ${c}80"></span>
        <span class="rc-name">${r.rep}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="rc-sub">
        <span class="rc-state" style="background:${c}18;border:1px solid ${c}40;color:${c}">${r.state}</span>
        <span class="rc-city">${r.city}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="rc-dots">
        <span class="rc-dot ${r.phone ? 'on' : 'off'}">📞</span>
        <span class="rc-dot ${r.email ? 'on' : 'off'}">✉</span>
        <span class="rc-dot ${r.web ? 'on' : 'off'}">🌐</span>
        <span class="rc-dot on" style="background:${c}18;border-color:${c}40;color:${c}">${bLabel}</span>
      </div>
    </div>`;
      }).join('');
    }

    function flyToRep(idx, el) {
      const r = filteredReps[idx]; if (!r) return;
      map.flyTo([r.lat, r.lng], 11, { duration: .7 });
      document.querySelectorAll('.rep-card').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('hl'));
      el.classList.add('hl');
      const layers = pinLayer.getLayers();
      if (layers[idx]) setTimeout(() => layers[idx].openPopup(), 750);
    }

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════
       STATS
    ═══════════════════════════════════════ */
    function updateStats() {
      const tCount = filteredReps.filter(r => r.brand === 'titus').length;
      const kCount = filteredReps.filter(r => r.brand === 'krueger').length;
      document.getElementById('sp-total').textContent = filteredReps.length;
      document.getElementById('sp-titus').textContent = tCount;
      document.getElementById('sp-krueger').textContent = kCount;
      document.getElementById('foot-txt').textContent =
        `${filteredReps.length} total locations · ${tCount} Titus · ${kCount} Krueger · ${new Set(filteredReps.map(r => r.state)).size} states`;
    }

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════
       CONTROLS
    ═══════════════════════════════════════ */
    function setVertical(btn, v) { document.querySelectorAll('.v-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active')); btn.classList.add('active'); activeVertical = v; recolorStates() }
    function setYear(btn, yr) { document.querySelectorAll('.yr-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active')); btn.classList.add('active'); activeYear = yr; recolorStates() }
    function filterRegion(btn) { document.querySelectorAll('.rgn-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active')); btn.classList.add('active'); activeRegion = btn.dataset.region; renderPins() }
    function filterBrand(btn) { document.querySelectorAll('.fb-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active')); btn.classList.add('active'); activeBrandFilter = btn.dataset.brand; renderPins() }
    document.getElementById('rep-search').addEventListener('input', e => { searchTerm = e.target.value; renderPins() });
    function showTab(tab, btn) { document.querySelectorAll('.side-tab').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active')); document.querySelectorAll('.side-panel').forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active')); btn.classList.add('active'); document.getElementById('panel-' + tab).classList.add('active') }

    /* Brand header toggles (show/hide on map) */
    function toggleBrand(brand, btn) {
      brandToggles[brand] = !brandToggles[brand];
      btn.classList.toggle('off', !brandToggles[brand]);
      renderPins();
    }
    function toggleLayer(which, btn) {
      btn.classList.toggle('on');
      if (which === 'heat') { heatVisible = btn.classList.contains('on'); heatVisible && stateLayer ? stateLayer.addTo(map) : stateLayer && map.removeLayer(stateLayer) }
      else { pinsVisible = btn.classList.contains('on'); pinsVisible ? pinLayer.addTo(map) : map.removeLayer(pinLayer) }
    }

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════
       HVAC MODAL
    ═══════════════════════════════════════ */
    function openStateModal(code) {
      const s = STATE_DATA[code];
      document.getElementById('m-title').innerHTML = `${s.name} <span>${code}</span>`;
      document.getElementById('m-region').textContent = s.region;
      const score = getScore(code, activeVertical, activeYear);
      document.getElementById('m-idx').textContent = `${score}/100`;
      const yoy = Math.round((YF[activeYear][activeVertical] - 1) * 100);
      const yoyEl = document.getElementById('m-yoy');
      yoyEl.textContent = `+${yoy}% vs 2025`;
      yoyEl.style.color = yoy > 10 ? 'var(--green)' : yoy > 5 ? 'var(--amber)' : 'var(--text)';

      const topV = Object.keys(VERTICALS).reduce((a, b) => getScore(code, a, activeYear) > getScore(code, b, activeYear) ? a : b);
      const totalVol = Object.keys(VERTICALS).reduce((s, v) => s + Math.round(getVol(v, code) * YF[activeYear][v]), 0);
      const avgScore = Math.round(Object.keys(VERTICALS).reduce((s, v) => s + getScore(code, v, activeYear), 0) / Object.keys(VERTICALS).length);
      const fcYears = ['2025', '2026', '2027', '2028'];
      const fcScores = fcYears.map(y => getScore(code, activeVertical, y));
      const fcMax = Math.max(...fcScores, 1);
      const vColor = VERTICALS[activeVertical].color;
      const vGrad = VERTICALS[activeVertical].grad;
      const drivers = getDrivers(code, activeVertical);

      // Reps by brand for this state
      const titusHere = ALL_REPS.filter(r => r.state === code && r.brand === 'titus');
      const kruegerHere = ALL_REPS.filter(r => r.state === code && r.brand === 'krueger');
      const tFirms = [...new Set(titusHere.map(r => r.rep))];
      const kFirms = [...new Set(kruegerHere.map(r => r.rep))];

      function repBrandSection(reps, firms, brand) {
        if (!firms.length) return `<div style="font-family:var(--font-m);font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);padding:6px 0">No ${brand} locations in this state.</div>`;
        return firms.map(firm => {
          const locs = reps.filter(r => r.rep === firm);
          return `<div style="margin-bottom:8px">
        <div class="brand-rep-name" style="color:${BRAND_COLOR[brand]}">${firm}</div>
        ${locs.map(r => `<div class="brand-rep-loc">
          ${[r.addr, r.city].filter(Boolean).length ? `<span>📍 ${[r.addr, r.city].filter(Boolean).join(', ')}</span>` : '<span>📍 ' + r.city + '</span>'}
          ${r.phone ? `<span>📞 ${r.phone}</span>` : ''}
          ${r.email ? `<a href="mailto:${r.email}" style="color:var(--accent)">✉ ${r.email}</a>` : ''}
        </div>`).join('')}
      </div>`;
        }).join('');
      }

      document.getElementById('modal-body').innerHTML = `
    <div>
      <div class="m-sec">Market Overview ${activeYear}</div>
      <div class="m-ov">
        <div class="m-ov-card"><div class="lbl">Composite Index</div><div class="val">${avgScore}</div><div class="sub">/ 100 all verticals</div></div>
        <div class="m-ov-card"><div class="lbl">Est. Total Volume</div><div class="val">$${(totalVol / 1000).toFixed(1)}B</div><div class="sub">all verticals · ${activeYear}</div></div>
        <div class="m-ov-card"><div class="lbl">Top Vertical</div><div class="val" style="font-size:14px;margin-top:3px">${VERTICALS[topV].icon} ${VERTICALS[topV].label}</div><div class="sub">score: ${getScore(code, topV, activeYear)}/100</div></div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div>
      <div class="m-sec">All Verticals · ${activeYear}</div>
      ${Object.entries(VERTICALS).map(([k, v], i) => {
        const sc = getScore(code, k, activeYear);
        const volM = Math.round(getVol(k, code) * YF[activeYear][k]);
        const trend = sc >= 80 ? '🔥 Peak' : sc >= 60 ? '⬆ High' : sc >= 40 ? '→ Moderate' : '⬇ Low';
        return `<div class="vr-row" style="animation-delay:${i * .04}s">
          <div class="vr-head"><span class="vr-icon">${v.icon}</span><span class="vr-name">${v.label}</span><span class="vr-score" style="color:${v.color}">${sc}</span></div>
          <div class="vr-bar-bg"><div class="vr-bar-fill" style="width:${sc}%;background:${v.grad}"></div></div>
          <div class="vr-detail"><span>Vol: <b>$${volM}M</b></span><span>Trend: <b>${trend}</b></span><span>CAGR: <b>${getCAGR(k)}%</b></span></div>
        </div>`;
      }).join('')}
    </div>
    <div>
      <div class="m-sec">${VERTICALS[activeVertical].icon} ${VERTICALS[activeVertical].label} · 4-Year Forecast</div>
      <div class="fc-wrap">
        <div class="fc-bars">
          ${fcYears.map((y, i) => { const sc = fcScores[i]; const h = Math.round((sc / fcMax) * 72); const isA = y === activeYear; return `<div class="fc-col"><div class="fc-v" style="color:${vColor}">${sc}</div><div class="fc-outer" style="height:${h}px;background:${isA ? vColor + '22' : 'var(--border)'}"><div class="fc-fill" style="height:${h}px;background:${vGrad};opacity:${isA ? 1 : .45}"></div></div><div class="fc-yr" style="${isA ? 'color:' + vColor : ''}">${y}</div></div>` }).join('')}
        </div>
        <div class="tag-row">${drivers.map(d => `<span class="tag ${d.t}">${d.l}</span>`).join('')}</div>
      </div>
    </div>

  padding: 4px 11px; border-radius: 20px; cursor: pointer;
  border: 1px solid var(--border); background: none;
  color: var(--muted2); transition: all .12s;
}
.chip-action:hover { color: var(--text); border-color: var(--border2); }

/* ── COMPARE TABLE ── */
.compare-meta {
  font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 10px;
  min-height: 18px;
}
.compare-meta strong { color: var(--accent); }

.compare-prompt {
  text-align: center; padding: 48px 20px;
  font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted2);
}
.compare-prompt .prompt-icon { font-size: 36px; opacity: .25; margin-bottom: 12px; }

.table-wrap { overflow-x: auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch; }

.compare-table {
  width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse;
  font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px;
}
.compare-table th {
  padding: 10px 12px; text-align: left;
  background: var(--surface2); border: 1px solid var(--border);
  font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--muted); white-space: nowrap; position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 2;
}
.compare-table th.desc-col {
  min-width: 200px; color: var(--muted);
}
.compare-table th.brand-col { min-width: 130px; }
.compare-table td {
  padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border);
  vertical-align: top; line-height: 1.5;
}
.compare-table tr:hover td { background: var(--surface2); }
.compare-table td.desc-cell {
  color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; max-width: 220px;
}
.compare-table td.empty-cell {
  color: var(--muted2); text-align: center; font-size: 13px;
}
.compare-table td.has-cell { color: var(--text); }

.model-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; }
.model-entry {
  font-size: 11px; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 3px;
  background: var(--bg); border: 1px solid var(--border);
  color: var(--text); white-space: nowrap; display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center; gap: 5px;
  cursor: pointer; transition: all .1s;
}
.model-entry:hover { background: rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.1); border-color: rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.4); }
.model-entry.copied { background: var(--accent3); color: #fff; border-color: var(--accent3); }
.model-entry-copy {
  font-size: 10px; padding: 0 3px; border-radius: 2px;
  background: var(--surface2); border: 1px solid var(--border2);
  color: var(--muted); opacity: 0; transition: opacity .1s; cursor: pointer;
}
.model-entry:hover .model-entry-copy { opacity: 1; }
.model-entry-copy:hover { background: var(--accent2); color: #fff; border-color: var(--accent2); }

@media (prefers-color-scheme: light) {
  .chip.selected {
    background: rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.1);
    border-color: rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.4);
  }
}


/* ── SEARCH HISTORY ── */
.history-bar {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap;
  min-height: 28px; margin-top: 10px;
}
.history-label {
  font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .1em; color: var(--muted2);
  text-transform: uppercase; flex-shrink: 0;
}
.history-chip {
  font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px;
  padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer;
  border: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--surface2);
  color: var(--muted); transition: all .12s; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px;
}
.history-chip:hover { border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent); background: rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.07); }
.history-chip-del {
  font-size: 10px; color: var(--muted2); line-height: 1;
  padding: 0 2px; border-radius: 2px; cursor: pointer;
}
.history-chip-del:hover { color: #ef4444; }
.history-clear {
  font-size: 10px; color: var(--muted2); cursor: pointer;
  background: none; border: none; font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
  padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px; margin-left: auto;
}
.history-clear:hover { color: var(--text); }

/* ── DID YOU MEAN ── */
.did-you-mean {
  text-align: center; padding: 24px 20px 16px;
}
.dym-title { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 10px; }
.dym-suggestions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; justify-content: center; }
.dym-chip {
  font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px;
  padding: 5px 14px; border-radius: 20px; cursor: pointer;
  border: 1px solid rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.4);
  background: rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.07); color: var(--accent);
  transition: all .12s;
}
.dym-chip:hover { background: var(--accent); color: var(--bg); }

/* ── EXPORT BUTTON ── */
.compare-actions {
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
  flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 10px;
}
.export-btn {
  font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px;
  padding: 5px 14px; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer;
  background: var(--surface2); color: var(--muted);
  border: 1px solid var(--border2); transition: all .15s;
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
}
.export-btn:hover { background: var(--accent3); color: #fff; border-color: var(--accent3); }

</style>
</head>

        <div class="eyebrow">// Air Distribution Cross-Reference Engine v3.0</div>

  </div>

  <!-- TAB 1: SEARCH -->
  <div class="tab-pane active" id="tab-search">
    <div class="search-zone">
      <div class="search-label">// enter any model number — any brand</div>
      <div class="search-wrapper">
        <span class="search-icon">⌕</span>
        <input
          type="text" id="searchInput" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false"

        <button class="clear-btn" id="clearBtn" title="Clear">✕</button>
      </div>

      <span class="history-label">Recent:</span>
      <span id="historyChips"></span>
      <button class="history-clear" id="historyClear" title="Clear history">Clear history</button>
    </div>
    </div>
    <div id="results">

        <div class="welcome-icon">⟷</div>

        <div class="welcome-sub" style="margin-top:6px;font-size:11px;opacity:.6;letter-spacing:.04em;">Powered by Triune Solutions</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- TAB 2: COMPARE -->
  <div class="tab-pane" id="tab-compare">
    <div class="compare-controls">
      <div>
        <div class="compare-label">// select category</div>
        <select id="catSelect"><option value="">— choose a category —</option></select>
      </div>
      <div id="brandChipsWrap" style="display:none">
        <div class="compare-label">// select brands to compare</div>
        <div class="brand-chips" id="brandChips">
          <button class="chip-action" id="selectAllChips">Select All</button>
          <button class="chip-action" id="clearChips">Clear All</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="compare-actions">
      <div class="compare-meta" id="compareMeta"></div>
      <button class="export-btn" id="exportCsvBtn" style="display:none">⬇ Export CSV</button>
    </div>
    <div id="compareOutput">
      <div class="compare-prompt">
        <div class="prompt-icon">⊞</div>
        Choose a category above to start comparing models across brands.
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>


</div>

// ── SEARCH INDEX ──
function buildIndex() {
  var idx = new Map();
  function addKey(key, ri) {
    if (!key) return;
    if (!idx.has(key)) idx.set(key, new Set());
    idx.get(key).add(ri);
  }
  DB.data.forEach(function(row, ri) {
    BRANDS.forEach(function(b) {
      if (!row[b]) return;
      // Split on both / and , to get individual tokens
      row[b].split(/[\/,]/).forEach(function(m) {
        var key = norm(m.trim());
        addKey(key, ri);
      });
    });
    // Also index description
    if (row.description) {
      addKey(norm(row.description), ri);
    }
  });
  return idx;
}
var IDX = buildIndex();

function norm(s) { return s.toLowerCase().replace(/[\s\-_\/]+/g, ''); }

// ── CAT CLASS ──
function catClass(cat) {
  var c = cat.toLowerCase();
  if (c.includes('grd')) return 'cat-GRD';
  if (c.includes('diffuser')) return 'cat-Diffusers';
  if (c.includes('grille') || c.includes('register')) return 'cat-Grilles';
  if (c.includes('beam')) return 'cat-Beams';
  if (c.includes('critical')) return 'cat-Critical';
  if (c.includes('displacement') || c.includes('underfloor')) return 'cat-Displacement';
  if (c.includes('vav')) return 'cat-VAV';
  if (c.includes('terminal')) return 'cat-Terminal';
  if (c.includes('fan') || c.includes('blower') || c.includes('exhaust') ||
      c.includes('propeller') || c.includes('ventilator') || c.includes('kitchen') ||
      c.includes('lab') || c.includes('bathroom') || c.includes('tunnel') ||
      c.includes('gravity') || c.includes('power') || c.includes('plenum') ||
      c.includes('inline') || c.includes('axial') || c.includes('utility') ||
      c.includes('hooded') || c.includes('centrifugal') || c.includes('supply')) return 'cat-Fan';
  if (c.includes('damper') || c.includes('smoke') || c.includes('fire')) return 'cat-Damper';
  if (c.includes('louver') || c.includes('penthouse')) return 'cat-Louver';
  if (c.includes('coil')) return 'cat-Coil';
  return 'cat-Other';
}

// ── HIGHLIGHT ──
function esc(s) {
  return s.replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/</g,'<').replace(/>/g,'>');
}
function highlight(text, query) {
  if (!query) return esc(text);
  var escaped = esc(text);
  var nq = norm(query);
  if (!nq) return escaped;
  try {
    var re = new RegExp(nq.split('').join('[\\s\\-_]*'), 'gi');
    return escaped.replace(re, function(m){ return '<mark>' + m + '</mark>'; });
  } catch(e) { return escaped; }
}

function renderCard(row, query, delay) {
  var card = document.createElement('div');
  card.className = 'card open';
  card.style.animationDelay = Math.min(delay, 300) + 'ms';
  var nq = norm(query);

  // Header
  var hdr = document.createElement('div');
  hdr.className = 'card-header';

  var badge = document.createElement('span');
  badge.className = 'cat-badge ' + catClass(row.category);
  badge.textContent = row.category;

  var desc = document.createElement('span');
  desc.className = 'card-desc';
  var descText = row.description || '';
  if (descText) {
    desc.innerHTML = highlight(descText, query);
  } else {
    // Collect all models from this row that match the query, show them as the title
    var matchedModels = [];
    BRANDS.forEach(function(b) {
      if (!row[b]) return;
      row[b].split(/[\/,]/).forEach(function(m) {
        m = m.trim();
        if (m && norm(m) === nq) matchedModels.push(b + ': ' + m);
      });
    });
    if (matchedModels.length > 0) {
      desc.innerHTML = '<span style="color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;font-weight:400">' + esc(matchedModels.join(' · ')) + '</span>';
    } else {
      desc.innerHTML = '<span style="color:var(--muted2);font-size:11px;font-weight:400">Cross-reference group</span>';
    }
  }

  // Count brands with data
  var matchedBrands = BRANDS.filter(function(b){ return row[b]; });
  var summary = document.createElement('span');
  summary.className = 'card-summary';
  summary.textContent = matchedBrands.length + ' brand' + (matchedBrands.length !== 1 ? 's' : '');

  var chev = document.createElement('span');
  chev.className = 'card-chevron';
  chev.textContent = '▼';

  hdr.appendChild(badge);
  hdr.appendChild(desc);
  hdr.appendChild(summary);
  hdr.appendChild(chev);
  hdr.addEventListener('click', function(){ toggleCard(card); });
  card.appendChild(hdr);

  // Body
  var body = document.createElement('div');
  body.className = 'card-body';

  var grid = document.createElement('div');
  grid.className = 'brand-grid';

  // Matched brand on top, rest alphabetical
  // Check exact match first, fall back to prefix match
  var sortedBrands = BRANDS.slice().sort(function(a, b) {
    var aHas = !!row[a], bHas = !!row[b];
    if (!aHas && !bHas) return 0;
    if (!aHas) return 1;
    if (!bHas) return -1;
    var aExact = nq && row[a].split(/[\/,]/).some(function(m){ return norm(m.trim()) === nq; });
    var bExact = nq && row[b].split(/[\/,]/).some(function(m){ return norm(m.trim()) === nq; });
    if (aExact && !bExact) return -1;
    if (!aExact && bExact) return 1;
    // Fall back to prefix match (e.g. "T3SQ" matches "T3SQ-0")
    var aPrefix = nq && row[a].split(/[\/,]/).some(function(m){ return norm(m.trim()).indexOf(nq) === 0; });
    var bPrefix = nq && row[b].split(/[\/,]/).some(function(m){ return norm(m.trim()).indexOf(nq) === 0; });
    if (aPrefix && !bPrefix) return -1;
    if (!aPrefix && bPrefix) return 1;
    return a.localeCompare(b);
  });

  sortedBrands.forEach(function(brand) {
    if (!row[brand]) return;
    var brandIdx = BRANDS.indexOf(brand);
    var cell = document.createElement('div');
    cell.className = 'brand-cell bc' + (brandIdx % 51);

    var nameEl = document.createElement('div');
    nameEl.className = 'brand-name';
    nameEl.textContent = brand;

    var modelsEl = document.createElement('div');
    modelsEl.className = 'brand-models';

    // Split on comma only — preserve slashes within model names (e.g. "w/SRA")
    var models = [];
    row[brand].split(',').forEach(function(m) {
      m = m.trim();
      if (m) models.push(m);
    });

    models.forEach(function(m) {
      var tag = document.createElement('div');
      tag.className = 'model-tag';
      // Main label
      var label = document.createElement('span');
      label.className = 'model-tag-text';
      label.innerHTML = highlight(m, query);
      // Copy button
      var copyBtn = document.createElement('span');
      copyBtn.className = 'model-tag-copy';
      copyBtn.textContent = '⎘';
      copyBtn.title = 'Copy ' + brand + ': ' + m;
      copyBtn.addEventListener('click', function(e){
        e.stopPropagation();
        copyModelText(m, brand, copyBtn);
      });
      tag.appendChild(label);
      tag.appendChild(copyBtn);
      // Click tag = Google search
      tag.addEventListener('click', function(e){ e.stopPropagation(); googleSearch(m, brand); });
      modelsEl.appendChild(tag);
    });

    cell.appendChild(nameEl);
    cell.appendChild(modelsEl);
    grid.appendChild(cell);
  });

  body.appendChild(grid);
  card.appendChild(body);
  return card;
}
