// FUZZY DID YOU MEAN
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function levenshtein(a, b) {
  var m = a.length, n = b.length;
  var dp = [];
  for (var i = 0; i <= m; i++) { dp[i] = [i]; }
  for (var j = 0; j <= n; j++) { dp[0][j] = j; }
  for (var i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
    for (var j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
      dp[i][j] = a[i-1] === b[j-1]
        ? dp[i-1][j-1]
        : 1 + Math.min(dp[i-1][j], dp[i][j-1], dp[i-1][j-1]);
    }
  }
  return dp[m][n];
}

function findSuggestions(query) {
  var nq = norm(query);
  if (nq.length < 2) return [];
  // Collect all unique model tokens from index
  var candidates = [];
  IDX.forEach(function(_, key) {
    if (Math.abs(key.length - nq.length) <= 3) {
      candidates.push(key);
    }
  });
  // Score by levenshtein distance
  var scored = candidates.map(function(c) {
    return { key: c, dist: levenshtein(nq, c) };
  }).filter(function(s) {
    // Allow up to 2 edits, or 30% of query length
    return s.dist <= Math.max(2, Math.floor(nq.length * 0.35)) && s.dist > 0;
  }).sort(function(a, b) { return a.dist - b.dist; });

  // Return top 5 unique original model strings
  var seen = new Set();
  var results = [];
  for (var i = 0; i < scored.length && results.length < 5; i++) {
    var key = scored[i].key;
    // Find original model string for this key
    var found = false;
    DB.data.forEach(function(row) {
      if (found) return;
      BRANDS.forEach(function(b) {
        if (!row[b] || found) return;
        row[b].split(/[,\/]/).forEach(function(m) {
          m = m.trim();
          if (norm(m) === key && !seen.has(m)) {
            seen.add(m);
            results.push(m);
            found = true;
          }
        });
      });
    });
  }
  return results;
}

function doSearch() {
  var query = document.getElementById('searchInput').value.trim();
  var results = document.getElementById('results');
  document.getElementById('clearBtn').style.display = query ? 'block' : 'none';

  if (!query) {
    results.innerHTML = '';
    var ws = document.createElement('div');
    ws.className = 'welcome-state';
    ws.id = 'welcomeState';
    ws.innerHTML = '<div class="welcome-icon">⟷</div><div class="welcome-title">Cross-Reference Any Model</div><div class="welcome-sub">Type a model number above — search all AD brands simultaneously and find every equivalent.</div><div class="welcome-sub" style="margin-top:6px;font-size:11px;opacity:.6;letter-spacing:.04em;">Powered by Triune Solutions</div>';
    results.appendChild(ws);
    return;
  }

  var nq = norm(query);
  if (!nq) return;

  // Helper: does this row have an exact token match for nq?
  function rowHasExact(row) {
    return BRANDS.some(function(br) {
      if (!row[br]) return false;
      return row[br].split(/[\/,]/).some(function(m) { return norm(m.trim()) === nq; });
    }) || (row.description && norm(row.description) === nq);
  }

  // Step 1: exact token matches only
  var exactHits = new Set();
  IDX.forEach(function(rowSet, key) {
    if (key === nq) rowSet.forEach(function(ri){ exactHits.add(ri); });
  });

  // Step 2: if no exact hits, fall back to partial substring match
  var hits;
  if (exactHits.size > 0) {
    hits = exactHits;
  } else {
    hits = new Set();
    IDX.forEach(function(rowSet, key) {
      if (key.indexOf(nq) >= 0) rowSet.forEach(function(ri){ hits.add(ri); });
    });
  }

  // Apply filter
  var filtered = Array.from(hits).map(function(ri){ return DB.data[ri]; });

  // Sort: exact description first, then exact model, then partial
  filtered.sort(function(a, b) {
    var aExact = rowHasExact(a);
    var bExact = rowHasExact(b);
    if (aExact && !bExact) return -1;
    if (!aExact && bExact) return 1;
    return 0;
  });

  results.innerHTML = '';

  if (filtered.length === 0) {
    var nm = document.createElement('div');
    nm.className = 'no-match';
    nm.innerHTML = '<div class="no-match-code">404</div><p>No matches for <strong style="color:var(--text)">' + esc(query) + '</strong> across ' + BRANDS.length + ' brands.</p>';

    // Did You Mean suggestions
    var suggestions = findSuggestions(query);
    if (suggestions.length) {
      var dym = document.createElement('div');
      dym.className = 'did-you-mean';
      dym.innerHTML = '<div class="dym-title">Did you mean…</div>';
      var chips = document.createElement('div');
      chips.className = 'dym-suggestions';
      suggestions.forEach(function(s) {
        var chip = document.createElement('button');
        chip.className = 'dym-chip';
        chip.textContent = s;
        chip.addEventListener('click', function() {
          document.getElementById('searchInput').value = s;
          doSearch();
        });
        chips.appendChild(chip);
      });
      dym.appendChild(chips);
      nm.appendChild(dym);
    }

    results.appendChild(nm);
    return;
  }

  var hdr = document.createElement('div');
  hdr.className = 'match-header';

  var cnt = document.createElement('div');
  cnt.className = 'match-count';
  cnt.innerHTML = 'Found <strong>' + filtered.length + '</strong> match' + (filtered.length !== 1 ? 'es' : '') + ' for <strong style="color:var(--text)">' + esc(query) + '</strong>';

  var toggleBtn = document.createElement('button');
  toggleBtn.className = 'toggle-all-btn';
  toggleBtn.textContent = '⊟ Collapse All';
  toggleBtn.addEventListener('click', function(){ toggleAll(toggleBtn); });

  hdr.appendChild(cnt);
  hdr.appendChild(toggleBtn);
  results.appendChild(hdr);

  filtered.forEach(function(row, i) {
    results.appendChild(renderCard(row, query, i * 30));
  });

}

var selectedCat = '';
var selectedBrands = {};

function buildChips(cat) {
  var wrap = document.getElementById('brandChipsWrap');
  var container = document.getElementById('brandChips');
  var catBrands = brandsPerCat[cat] || {};
  var brandList = BRANDS.filter(function(b) { return catBrands[b]; }).sort();

  if (!brandList.length) { wrap.style.display = 'none'; return; }

  // Clear existing chips (keep action buttons)
  var chips = container.querySelectorAll('.chip');
  chips.forEach(function(c) { c.parentNode.removeChild(c); });

  // Rebuild selected state — keep previously selected brands that exist in new cat
  var newSelected = {};
  brandList.forEach(function(b) {
    if (selectedBrands[b]) newSelected[b] = true;
  });
  selectedBrands = newSelected;

  brandList.forEach(function(b) {
    var chip = document.createElement('button');
    chip.className = 'chip' + (selectedBrands[b] ? ' selected' : '');
    chip.textContent = b;
    chip.dataset.brand = b;
    chip.addEventListener('click', function() {
      if (selectedBrands[b]) {
        delete selectedBrands[b];
        chip.classList.remove('selected');
      } else {
        selectedBrands[b] = true;
        chip.classList.add('selected');
      }
      renderTable();
    });
    container.appendChild(chip);
  });

  wrap.style.display = 'block';
}

    selectedBrands[b] = true;
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('#brandChips .chip').forEach(function(c) { c.classList.add('selected'); });

});

  selectedBrands = {};
  document.querySelectorAll('#brandChips .chip').forEach(function(c) { c.classList.remove('selected'); });

function copyCompareModel(model, brand, el) {
  var text = brand + ': ' + model;
  function done() {
    el.classList.add('copied');
    var orig = el.textContent;
    el.textContent = '✓';
    setTimeout(function() {
      el.classList.remove('copied');
      el.textContent = orig;
    }, 1200);
  }
  if (navigator.clipboard) {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(done).catch(function() {
      try { var ta = document.createElement('textarea'); ta.value = text; document.body.appendChild(ta); ta.select(); document.execCommand('copy'); document.body.removeChild(ta); done(); } catch(e) {}
    });
  } else {
    try { var ta = document.createElement('textarea'); ta.value = text; document.body.appendChild(ta); ta.select(); document.execCommand('copy'); document.body.removeChild(ta); done(); } catch(e) {}
  }
}

function renderTable() {
  var output = document.getElementById('compareOutput');
  var meta   = document.getElementById('compareMeta');

  var brands = BRANDS.filter(function(b) { return selectedBrands[b]; });

  if (!selectedCat) {
    meta.innerHTML = '';
    document.getElementById('exportCsvBtn').style.display = 'none';
    output.innerHTML = '<div class="compare-prompt"><div class="prompt-icon">⊞</div>Choose a category above to start comparing models across brands.</div>';
    return;
  }

  if (brands.length < 2) {
    meta.innerHTML = '';
    output.innerHTML = '<div class="compare-prompt"><div class="prompt-icon">↕</div>Select at least <strong>2 brands</strong> to generate a comparison table.</div>';
    return;
  }

  // Filter rows: in selected category + has at least one selected brand
  var rows = DB.data.filter(function(row) {
    if (row.category !== selectedCat) return false;
    return brands.some(function(b) { return row[b]; });
  });

  _lastCompareRows = rows;
  _lastCompareBrands = brands;
  document.getElementById('exportCsvBtn').style.display = rows.length ? 'flex' : 'none';

  meta.innerHTML = 'Showing <strong>' + rows.length + '</strong> group' + (rows.length !== 1 ? 's' : '') +
    ' across <strong>' + brands.length + '</strong> brand' + (brands.length !== 1 ? 's' : '') +
    ' in <strong>' + esc(selectedCat) + '</strong>';

  if (!rows.length) {
    output.innerHTML = '<div class="compare-prompt"><div class="prompt-icon">∅</div>No product groups found for this combination.</div>';
    return;
  }

  var html = '<div class="table-wrap"><table class="compare-table"><thead><tr>';
  html += '<th class="desc-col">Description / Group</th>';
  brands.forEach(function(b) {
    html += '<th class="brand-col">' + esc(b) + '</th>';
  });
  html += '</tr></thead><tbody>';

  rows.forEach(function(row) {
    html += '<tr>';

    // Description cell
    var descText = row.description || row.category || '';
    html += '<td class="desc-cell">' + esc(descText) + '</td>';

    // Brand cells
    brands.forEach(function(b) {
      var val = row[b] || '';
      if (!val) {
        html += '<td class="empty-cell">—</td>';
      } else {
        var models = val.split(',').map(function(m) { return m.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
        html += '<td class="has-cell"><div class="model-list">';
        models.forEach(function(m) {
          html += '<span class="model-entry" data-model="' + esc(m) + '" data-brand="' + esc(b) + '">' +
            '<span class="model-entry-text">' + esc(m) + '</span>' +
            '<span class="model-entry-copy" title="Copy ' + esc(b) + ': ' + esc(m) + '">⎘</span>' +
            '</span>';
        });
        html += '</div></td>';
      }
    });

    html += '</tr>';
  });

  html += '</tbody></table></div>';
  output.innerHTML = html;

  // Attach copy handlers
  output.querySelectorAll('.model-entry').forEach(function(el) {
    // Click entry = Google search
    el.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      if (e.target.classList.contains('model-entry-copy')) return;
      googleSearch(el.dataset.model, el.dataset.brand);
    });
    // Click copy icon = copy to clipboard
    var copyBtn = el.querySelector('.model-entry-copy');
    if (copyBtn) {
      copyBtn.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        e.stopPropagation();
        copyModelText(el.dataset.model, el.dataset.brand, copyBtn);
      });
    }
  });
}

var _lastCompareRows = [];
var _lastCompareBrands = [];

function exportCompareCsv() {
  if (!_lastCompareRows.length || !_lastCompareBrands.length) return;
  var lines = [];
  // Header
  var header = ['Description'].concat(_lastCompareBrands.map(function(b) {
    return '"' + b.replace(/"/g, '""') + '"';
  }));
  lines.push(header.join(','));
  // Rows
  _lastCompareRows.forEach(function(row) {
    var cols = ['"' + (row.description || row.category || '').replace(/"/g, '""') + '"'];
    _lastCompareBrands.forEach(function(b) {
      var val = row[b] || '';
      cols.push('"' + val.replace(/"/g, '""') + '"');
    });
    lines.push(cols.join(','));
  });
  var csv = lines.join('\n');
  var blob = new Blob([csv], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
  var url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  var a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = url;
  a.download = 'xref-compare-' + (selectedCat || 'export').replace(/[^a-z0-9]/gi, '-').toLowerCase() + '.csv';
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  document.body.removeChild(a);
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
}

document.getElementById('exportCsvBtn').addEventListener('click', exportCompareCsv);

/* ── TABS ── */
.tab-bar {
  display: flex; gap: 4px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  margin-bottom: 28px; margin-top: -8px;
}
.tab-btn {
  font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: .06em;
  padding: 10px 20px; background: none; border: none;
  border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; color: var(--muted);
  cursor: pointer; transition: all .15s; margin-bottom: -1px;
}
.tab-btn:hover { color: var(--text); }
.tab-btn.active { color: var(--accent); border-bottom-color: var(--accent); }

.tab-pane { display: none; }
.tab-pane.active { display: block; }

/* ── COMPARE TAB ── */
.compare-controls {
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px;
  margin-bottom: 24px;
}
.compare-label {
  font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .15em; color: var(--muted);
  text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 6px;
}
#catSelect {
  width: 100%; max-width: 420px;
  padding: 10px 14px; background: var(--surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--border2); border-radius: var(--radius);
  color: var(--text); font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; font-size: 13px;
  outline: none; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color .2s;
}
#catSelect:focus { border-color: var(--accent); }

.brand-chips {
  display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; align-items: center;
}
.chip {
  font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px;
  padding: 4px 11px; border-radius: 20px; cursor: pointer;
  border: 1px solid var(--border2); background: var(--surface2);
  color: var(--muted); transition: all .12s; user-select: none;
}
.chip:hover { border-color: var(--border2); color: var(--text); }
.chip.selected {
  background: rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.12);
  border-color: rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.45);
  color: var(--accent);
}
.chip-action {
  font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px;
  padding: 4px 11px; border-radius: 20px; cursor: pointer;
  border: 1px solid var(--border); background: none;
  color: var(--muted2); transition: all .12s;
}
.chip-action:hover { color: var(--text); border-color: var(--border2); }

/* ── COMPARE TABLE ── */
.compare-meta {
  font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 10px;
  min-height: 18px;
}
.compare-meta strong { color: var(--accent); }

.compare-prompt {
  text-align: center; padding: 48px 20px;
  font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted2);
}
.compare-prompt .prompt-icon { font-size: 36px; opacity: .25; margin-bottom: 12px; }

.table-wrap { overflow-x: auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch; }

.compare-table {
  width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse;
  font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px;
}
.compare-table th {
  padding: 10px 12px; text-align: left;
  background: var(--surface2); border: 1px solid var(--border);
  font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--muted); white-space: nowrap; position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 2;
}
.compare-table th.desc-col {
  min-width: 200px; color: var(--muted);
}
.compare-table th.brand-col { min-width: 130px; }
.compare-table td {
  padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border);
  vertical-align: top; line-height: 1.5;
}
.compare-table tr:hover td { background: var(--surface2); }
.compare-table td.desc-cell {
  color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; max-width: 220px;
}
.compare-table td.empty-cell {
  color: var(--muted2); text-align: center; font-size: 13px;
}
.compare-table td.has-cell { color: var(--text); }

.model-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; }
.model-entry {
  font-size: 11px; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 3px;
  background: var(--bg); border: 1px solid var(--border);
  color: var(--text); white-space: nowrap; display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center; gap: 5px;
  cursor: pointer; transition: all .1s;
}
.model-entry:hover { background: rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.1); border-color: rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.4); }
.model-entry.copied { background: var(--accent3); color: #fff; border-color: var(--accent3); }
.model-entry-copy {
  font-size: 10px; padding: 0 3px; border-radius: 2px;
  background: var(--surface2); border: 1px solid var(--border2);
  color: var(--muted); opacity: 0; transition: opacity .1s; cursor: pointer;
}
.model-entry:hover .model-entry-copy { opacity: 1; }
.model-entry-copy:hover { background: var(--accent2); color: #fff; border-color: var(--accent2); }

@media (prefers-color-scheme: light) {
  .chip.selected {
    background: rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.1);
    border-color: rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.4);
  }
}


/* ── SEARCH HISTORY ── */
.history-bar {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap;
  min-height: 28px; margin-top: 10px;
}
.history-label {
  font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .1em; color: var(--muted2);
  text-transform: uppercase; flex-shrink: 0;
}
.history-chip {
  font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px;
  padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer;
  border: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--surface2);
  color: var(--muted); transition: all .12s; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px;
}
.history-chip:hover { border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent); background: rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.07); }
.history-chip-del {
  font-size: 10px; color: var(--muted2); line-height: 1;
  padding: 0 2px; border-radius: 2px; cursor: pointer;
}
.history-chip-del:hover { color: #ef4444; }
.history-clear {
  font-size: 10px; color: var(--muted2); cursor: pointer;
  background: none; border: none; font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
  padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px; margin-left: auto;
}
.history-clear:hover { color: var(--text); }

/* ── DID YOU MEAN ── */
.did-you-mean {
  text-align: center; padding: 24px 20px 16px;
}
.dym-title { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 10px; }
.dym-suggestions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; justify-content: center; }
.dym-chip {
  font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px;
  padding: 5px 14px; border-radius: 20px; cursor: pointer;
  border: 1px solid rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.4);
  background: rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.07); color: var(--accent);
  transition: all .12s;
}
.dym-chip:hover { background: var(--accent); color: var(--bg); }

/* ── EXPORT BUTTON ── */
.compare-actions {
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
  flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 10px;
}
.export-btn {
  font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px;
  padding: 5px 14px; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer;
  background: var(--surface2); color: var(--muted);
  border: 1px solid var(--border2); transition: all .15s;
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
}
.export-btn:hover { background: var(--accent3); color: #fff; border-color: var(--accent3); }

</style>
</head>

// ── SEARCH INDEX ──
function buildIndex() {
  var idx = new Map();
  function addKey(key, ri) {
    if (!key) return;
    if (!idx.has(key)) idx.set(key, new Set());
    idx.get(key).add(ri);
  }
  DB.data.forEach(function(row, ri) {
    BRANDS.forEach(function(b) {
      if (!row[b]) return;
      // Split on both / and , to get individual tokens
      row[b].split(/[\/,]/).forEach(function(m) {
        var key = norm(m.trim());
        addKey(key, ri);
      });
    });
    // Also index description
    if (row.description) {
      addKey(norm(row.description), ri);
    }
  });
  return idx;
}
var IDX = buildIndex();

function norm(s) { return s.toLowerCase().replace(/[\s\-_\/]+/g, ''); }

// ── CAT CLASS ──
function catClass(cat) {
  var c = cat.toLowerCase();
  if (c.includes('grd')) return 'cat-GRD';
  if (c.includes('diffuser')) return 'cat-Diffusers';
  if (c.includes('grille') || c.includes('register')) return 'cat-Grilles';
  if (c.includes('beam')) return 'cat-Beams';
  if (c.includes('critical')) return 'cat-Critical';
  if (c.includes('displacement') || c.includes('underfloor')) return 'cat-Displacement';
  if (c.includes('vav')) return 'cat-VAV';
  if (c.includes('terminal')) return 'cat-Terminal';
  if (c.includes('fan') || c.includes('blower') || c.includes('exhaust') ||
      c.includes('propeller') || c.includes('ventilator') || c.includes('kitchen') ||
      c.includes('lab') || c.includes('bathroom') || c.includes('tunnel') ||
      c.includes('gravity') || c.includes('power') || c.includes('plenum') ||
      c.includes('inline') || c.includes('axial') || c.includes('utility') ||
      c.includes('hooded') || c.includes('centrifugal') || c.includes('supply')) return 'cat-Fan';
  if (c.includes('damper') || c.includes('smoke') || c.includes('fire')) return 'cat-Damper';
  if (c.includes('louver') || c.includes('penthouse')) return 'cat-Louver';
  if (c.includes('coil')) return 'cat-Coil';
  return 'cat-Other';
}

// ── HIGHLIGHT ──
function esc(s) {
  return s.replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/</g,'<').replace(/>/g,'>');
}
function highlight(text, query) {
  if (!query) return esc(text);
  var escaped = esc(text);
  var nq = norm(query);
  if (!nq) return escaped;
  try {
    var re = new RegExp(nq.split('').join('[\\s\\-_]*'), 'gi');
    return escaped.replace(re, function(m){ return '<mark>' + m + '</mark>'; });
  } catch(e) { return escaped; }
}

function renderCard(row, query, delay) {

  hdr.className = 'card-header';

  badge.textContent = row.category;

  var desc = document.createElement('span');
  desc.className = 'card-desc';
  var descText = row.description || '';
  if (descText) {
    desc.innerHTML = highlight(descText, query);
  } else {
    // Collect all models from this row that match the query, show them as the title
    var matchedModels = [];
    BRANDS.forEach(function(b) {
      if (!row[b]) return;
      row[b].split(/[\/,]/).forEach(function(m) {
        m = m.trim();
        if (m && norm(m) === nq) matchedModels.push(b + ': ' + m);
      });
    });
    if (matchedModels.length > 0) {
      desc.innerHTML = '<span style="color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;font-weight:400">' + esc(matchedModels.join(' · ')) + '</span>';
    } else {
      desc.innerHTML = '<span style="color:var(--muted2);font-size:11px;font-weight:400">Cross-reference group</span>';
    }
  }

  // Count brands with data
  var matchedBrands = BRANDS.filter(function(b){ return row[b]; });
  var summary = document.createElement('span');
  summary.className = 'card-summary';
  summary.textContent = matchedBrands.length + ' brand' + (matchedBrands.length !== 1 ? 's' : '');

  var chev = document.createElement('span');
  chev.className = 'card-chevron';
  chev.textContent = '▼';

  hdr.appendChild(badge);
  hdr.appendChild(desc);
  hdr.appendChild(summary);
  hdr.appendChild(chev);
  hdr.addEventListener('click', function(){ toggleCard(card); });
  card.appendChild(hdr);

  // Body
  var body = document.createElement('div');
  body.className = 'card-body';

  var grid = document.createElement('div');
  grid.className = 'brand-grid';

  // Matched brand on top, rest alphabetical
  // Check exact match first, fall back to prefix match
  var sortedBrands = BRANDS.slice().sort(function(a, b) {
    var aHas = !!row[a], bHas = !!row[b];
    if (!aHas && !bHas) return 0;
    if (!aHas) return 1;
    if (!bHas) return -1;
    var aExact = nq && row[a].split(/[\/,]/).some(function(m){ return norm(m.trim()) === nq; });
    var bExact = nq && row[b].split(/[\/,]/).some(function(m){ return norm(m.trim()) === nq; });
    if (aExact && !bExact) return -1;
    if (!aExact && bExact) return 1;
    // Fall back to prefix match (e.g. "T3SQ" matches "T3SQ-0")
    var aPrefix = nq && row[a].split(/[\/,]/).some(function(m){ return norm(m.trim()).indexOf(nq) === 0; });
    var bPrefix = nq && row[b].split(/[\/,]/).some(function(m){ return norm(m.trim()).indexOf(nq) === 0; });
    if (aPrefix && !bPrefix) return -1;
    if (!aPrefix && bPrefix) return 1;
    return a.localeCompare(b);
  });

  sortedBrands.forEach(function(brand) {
    if (!row[brand]) return;
    var brandIdx = BRANDS.indexOf(brand);
    var cell = document.createElement('div');
    cell.className = 'brand-cell bc' + (brandIdx % 51);

    var nameEl = document.createElement('div');
    nameEl.className = 'brand-name';
    nameEl.textContent = brand;

    var modelsEl = document.createElement('div');
    modelsEl.className = 'brand-models';

    // Split on comma only — preserve slashes within model names (e.g. "w/SRA")
    var models = [];
    row[brand].split(',').forEach(function(m) {
      m = m.trim();
      if (m) models.push(m);
    });

    models.forEach(function(m) {
      var tag = document.createElement('div');
      tag.className = 'model-tag';
      // Main label
      var label = document.createElement('span');
      label.className = 'model-tag-text';
      label.innerHTML = highlight(m, query);
      // Copy button
      var copyBtn = document.createElement('span');
      copyBtn.className = 'model-tag-copy';
      copyBtn.textContent = '⎘';
      copyBtn.title = 'Copy ' + brand + ': ' + m;
      copyBtn.addEventListener('click', function(e){
        e.stopPropagation();
        copyModelText(m, brand, copyBtn);
      });
      tag.appendChild(label);
      tag.appendChild(copyBtn);
      // Click tag = Google search
      tag.addEventListener('click', function(e){ e.stopPropagation(); googleSearch(m, brand); });
      modelsEl.appendChild(tag);
    });

    cell.appendChild(nameEl);
    cell.appendChild(modelsEl);
    grid.appendChild(cell);
  });

  body.appendChild(grid);
  card.appendChild(body);
  return card;
}

// FUZZY DID YOU MEAN
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function levenshtein(a, b) {
  var m = a.length, n = b.length;
  var dp = [];
  for (var i = 0; i <= m; i++) { dp[i] = [i]; }
  for (var j = 0; j <= n; j++) { dp[0][j] = j; }
  for (var i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
    for (var j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
      dp[i][j] = a[i-1] === b[j-1]
        ? dp[i-1][j-1]
        : 1 + Math.min(dp[i-1][j], dp[i][j-1], dp[i-1][j-1]);
    }
  }
  return dp[m][n];
}

function findSuggestions(query) {
  var nq = norm(query);
  if (nq.length < 2) return [];
  // Collect all unique model tokens from index
  var candidates = [];
  IDX.forEach(function(_, key) {
    if (Math.abs(key.length - nq.length) <= 3) {
      candidates.push(key);
    }
  });
  // Score by levenshtein distance
  var scored = candidates.map(function(c) {
    return { key: c, dist: levenshtein(nq, c) };
  }).filter(function(s) {
    // Allow up to 2 edits, or 30% of query length
    return s.dist <= Math.max(2, Math.floor(nq.length * 0.35)) && s.dist > 0;
  }).sort(function(a, b) { return a.dist - b.dist; });

  // Return top 5 unique original model strings
  var seen = new Set();
  var results = [];
  for (var i = 0; i < scored.length && results.length < 5; i++) {
    var key = scored[i].key;
    // Find original model string for this key
    var found = false;
    DB.data.forEach(function(row) {
      if (found) return;
      BRANDS.forEach(function(b) {
        if (!row[b] || found) return;
        row[b].split(/[,\/]/).forEach(function(m) {
          m = m.trim();
          if (norm(m) === key && !seen.has(m)) {
            seen.add(m);
            results.push(m);
            found = true;
          }
        });
      });
    });
  }
  return results;
}

function doSearch() {
  var query = document.getElementById('searchInput').value.trim();
  var results = document.getElementById('results');
  document.getElementById('clearBtn').style.display = query ? 'block' : 'none';

  if (!query) {
    results.innerHTML = '';
    var ws = document.createElement('div');
    ws.className = 'welcome-state';
    ws.id = 'welcomeState';
    ws.innerHTML = '<div class="welcome-icon">⟷</div><div class="welcome-title">Cross-Reference Any Model</div><div class="welcome-sub">Type a model number above — search all AD brands simultaneously and find every equivalent.</div><div class="welcome-sub" style="margin-top:6px;font-size:11px;opacity:.6;letter-spacing:.04em;">Powered by Triune Solutions</div>';
    results.appendChild(ws);
    return;
  }

  var nq = norm(query);
  if (!nq) return;

  // Helper: does this row have an exact token match for nq?
  function rowHasExact(row) {
    return BRANDS.some(function(br) {
      if (!row[br]) return false;
      return row[br].split(/[\/,]/).some(function(m) { return norm(m.trim()) === nq; });
    }) || (row.description && norm(row.description) === nq);
  }

  // Step 1: exact token matches only
  var exactHits = new Set();
  IDX.forEach(function(rowSet, key) {
    if (key === nq) rowSet.forEach(function(ri){ exactHits.add(ri); });
  });

  // Step 2: if no exact hits, fall back to partial substring match
  var hits;
  if (exactHits.size > 0) {
    hits = exactHits;
  } else {
    hits = new Set();
    IDX.forEach(function(rowSet, key) {
      if (key.indexOf(nq) >= 0) rowSet.forEach(function(ri){ hits.add(ri); });
    });
  }

  // Apply filter
  var filtered = Array.from(hits).map(function(ri){ return DB.data[ri]; });

  // Sort: exact description first, then exact model, then partial
  filtered.sort(function(a, b) {
    var aExact = rowHasExact(a);
    var bExact = rowHasExact(b);
    if (aExact && !bExact) return -1;
    if (!aExact && bExact) return 1;
    return 0;
  });

  results.innerHTML = '';

  if (filtered.length === 0) {
    var nm = document.createElement('div');
    nm.className = 'no-match';
    nm.innerHTML = '<div class="no-match-code">404</div><p>No matches for <strong style="color:var(--text)">' + esc(query) + '</strong> across ' + BRANDS.length + ' brands.</p>';

    // Did You Mean suggestions
    var suggestions = findSuggestions(query);
    if (suggestions.length) {
      var dym = document.createElement('div');
      dym.className = 'did-you-mean';
      dym.innerHTML = '<div class="dym-title">Did you mean…</div>';
      var chips = document.createElement('div');
      chips.className = 'dym-suggestions';
      suggestions.forEach(function(s) {
        var chip = document.createElement('button');
        chip.className = 'dym-chip';
        chip.textContent = s;
        chip.addEventListener('click', function() {
          document.getElementById('searchInput').value = s;
          doSearch();
        });
        chips.appendChild(chip);
      });
      dym.appendChild(chips);
      nm.appendChild(dym);
    }

    results.appendChild(nm);
    return;
  }

  var hdr = document.createElement('div');
  hdr.className = 'match-header';

  var cnt = document.createElement('div');
  cnt.className = 'match-count';
  cnt.innerHTML = 'Found <strong>' + filtered.length + '</strong> match' + (filtered.length !== 1 ? 'es' : '') + ' for <strong style="color:var(--text)">' + esc(query) + '</strong>';

  var toggleBtn = document.createElement('button');
  toggleBtn.className = 'toggle-all-btn';
  toggleBtn.textContent = '⊟ Collapse All';
  toggleBtn.addEventListener('click', function(){ toggleAll(toggleBtn); });

  hdr.appendChild(cnt);
  hdr.appendChild(toggleBtn);
  results.appendChild(hdr);

  filtered.forEach(function(row, i) {
    results.appendChild(renderCard(row, query, i * 30));
  });

}



// ── INPUT ──
var historyTimer = null;
document.getElementById('searchInput').addEventListener('input', function() {
  clearTimeout(debounceTimer);
  debounceTimer = setTimeout(doSearch, 160);
  // Save to history after 5 seconds of inactivity
  clearTimeout(historyTimer);
  var q = this.value.trim();
  if (q.length >= 2) {
    historyTimer = setTimeout(function() { addToHistory(q); }, 5000);
  }
});
document.getElementById('searchInput').addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
  if (e.key === 'Escape') {
    this.value = '';
    doSearch();
  }
  if (e.key === 'Enter') {
    clearTimeout(debounceTimer);
    clearTimeout(historyTimer);
    doSearch();
    var q = this.value.trim();
    if (q.length >= 2) addToHistory(q);
  }
});
document.getElementById('clearBtn').addEventListener('click', function() {
  document.getElementById('searchInput').value = '';
  doSearch();
  document.getElementById('searchInput').focus();
});

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// TAB SWITCHING
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(function(btn) {
  btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(function(b) { b.classList.remove('active'); });
    document.querySelectorAll('.tab-pane').forEach(function(p) { p.classList.remove('active'); });
    btn.classList.add('active');
    document.getElementById('tab-' + btn.dataset.tab).classList.add('active');
  });
});

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// COMPARE TAB
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// Build sorted category list and brandsPerCat lookup
var CATEGORIES = [];
var brandsPerCat = {};
(function() {
  var catSet = {};
  DB.data.forEach(function(row) {
    var cat = row.category;
    if (!cat) return;
    catSet[cat] = true;
    if (!brandsPerCat[cat]) brandsPerCat[cat] = {};
    BRANDS.forEach(function(b) {
      if (row[b]) brandsPerCat[cat][b] = true;
    });
  });
  CATEGORIES = Object.keys(catSet).sort();

  // Populate category dropdown
  var sel = document.getElementById('catSelect');
  CATEGORIES.forEach(function(cat) {
    var opt = document.createElement('option');
    opt.value = cat;
    opt.textContent = cat;
    sel.appendChild(opt);
  });
})();

var selectedCat = '';
var selectedBrands = {};

function buildChips(cat) {
  var wrap = document.getElementById('brandChipsWrap');
  var container = document.getElementById('brandChips');
  var catBrands = brandsPerCat[cat] || {};
  var brandList = BRANDS.filter(function(b) { return catBrands[b]; }).sort();

  if (!brandList.length) { wrap.style.display = 'none'; return; }

  // Clear existing chips (keep action buttons)
  var chips = container.querySelectorAll('.chip');
  chips.forEach(function(c) { c.parentNode.removeChild(c); });

  // Rebuild selected state — keep previously selected brands that exist in new cat
  var newSelected = {};
  brandList.forEach(function(b) {
    if (selectedBrands[b]) newSelected[b] = true;
  });
  selectedBrands = newSelected;

  brandList.forEach(function(b) {
    var chip = document.createElement('button');
    chip.className = 'chip' + (selectedBrands[b] ? ' selected' : '');
    chip.textContent = b;
    chip.dataset.brand = b;
    chip.addEventListener('click', function() {
      if (selectedBrands[b]) {
        delete selectedBrands[b];
        chip.classList.remove('selected');
      } else {
        selectedBrands[b] = true;
        chip.classList.add('selected');
      }
      renderTable();
    });
    container.appendChild(chip);
  });

  wrap.style.display = 'block';
}

document.getElementById('selectAllChips').addEventListener('click', function() {
  if (!selectedCat) return;
  var catBrands = brandsPerCat[selectedCat] || {};
  BRANDS.filter(function(b) { return catBrands[b]; }).forEach(function(b) {
    selectedBrands[b] = true;
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('#brandChips .chip').forEach(function(c) { c.classList.add('selected'); });
  renderTable();
});

document.getElementById('clearChips').addEventListener('click', function() {
  selectedBrands = {};
  document.querySelectorAll('#brandChips .chip').forEach(function(c) { c.classList.remove('selected'); });
  renderTable();
});

document.getElementById('catSelect').addEventListener('change', function() {
  selectedCat = this.value;
  selectedBrands = {};
  buildChips(selectedCat);
  renderTable();
});

function copyCompareModel(model, brand, el) {
  var text = brand + ': ' + model;
  function done() {
    el.classList.add('copied');
    var orig = el.textContent;
    el.textContent = '✓';
    setTimeout(function() {
      el.classList.remove('copied');
      el.textContent = orig;
    }, 1200);
  }
  if (navigator.clipboard) {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(done).catch(function() {
      try { var ta = document.createElement('textarea'); ta.value = text; document.body.appendChild(ta); ta.select(); document.execCommand('copy'); document.body.removeChild(ta); done(); } catch(e) {}
    });
  } else {
    try { var ta = document.createElement('textarea'); ta.value = text; document.body.appendChild(ta); ta.select(); document.execCommand('copy'); document.body.removeChild(ta); done(); } catch(e) {}
  }
}

function renderTable() {
  var output = document.getElementById('compareOutput');
  var meta   = document.getElementById('compareMeta');

  var brands = BRANDS.filter(function(b) { return selectedBrands[b]; });

  if (!selectedCat) {
    meta.innerHTML = '';
    document.getElementById('exportCsvBtn').style.display = 'none';
    output.innerHTML = '<div class="compare-prompt"><div class="prompt-icon">⊞</div>Choose a category above to start comparing models across brands.</div>';
    return;
  }

  if (brands.length < 2) {
    meta.innerHTML = '';
    output.innerHTML = '<div class="compare-prompt"><div class="prompt-icon">↕</div>Select at least <strong>2 brands</strong> to generate a comparison table.</div>';
    return;
  }

  // Filter rows: in selected category + has at least one selected brand
  var rows = DB.data.filter(function(row) {
    if (row.category !== selectedCat) return false;
    return brands.some(function(b) { return row[b]; });
  });

  _lastCompareRows = rows;
  _lastCompareBrands = brands;
  document.getElementById('exportCsvBtn').style.display = rows.length ? 'flex' : 'none';

  meta.innerHTML = 'Showing <strong>' + rows.length + '</strong> group' + (rows.length !== 1 ? 's' : '') +
    ' across <strong>' + brands.length + '</strong> brand' + (brands.length !== 1 ? 's' : '') +
    ' in <strong>' + esc(selectedCat) + '</strong>';

  if (!rows.length) {
    output.innerHTML = '<div class="compare-prompt"><div class="prompt-icon">∅</div>No product groups found for this combination.</div>';
    return;
  }

  var html = '<div class="table-wrap"><table class="compare-table"><thead><tr>';
  html += '<th class="desc-col">Description / Group</th>';
  brands.forEach(function(b) {
    html += '<th class="brand-col">' + esc(b) + '</th>';
  });
  html += '</tr></thead><tbody>';

  rows.forEach(function(row) {
    html += '<tr>';

    // Description cell
    var descText = row.description || row.category || '';
    html += '<td class="desc-cell">' + esc(descText) + '</td>';

    // Brand cells
    brands.forEach(function(b) {
      var val = row[b] || '';
      if (!val) {
        html += '<td class="empty-cell">—</td>';
      } else {
        var models = val.split(',').map(function(m) { return m.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
        html += '<td class="has-cell"><div class="model-list">';
        models.forEach(function(m) {
          html += '<span class="model-entry" data-model="' + esc(m) + '" data-brand="' + esc(b) + '">' +
            '<span class="model-entry-text">' + esc(m) + '</span>' +
            '<span class="model-entry-copy" title="Copy ' + esc(b) + ': ' + esc(m) + '">⎘</span>' +
            '</span>';
        });
        html += '</div></td>';
      }
    });

    html += '</tr>';
  });

  html += '</tbody></table></div>';
  output.innerHTML = html;

  // Attach copy handlers
  output.querySelectorAll('.model-entry').forEach(function(el) {
    // Click entry = Google search
    el.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      if (e.target.classList.contains('model-entry-copy')) return;
      googleSearch(el.dataset.model, el.dataset.brand);
    });
    // Click copy icon = copy to clipboard
    var copyBtn = el.querySelector('.model-entry-copy');
    if (copyBtn) {
      copyBtn.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        e.stopPropagation();
        copyModelText(el.dataset.model, el.dataset.brand, copyBtn);
      });
    }
  });
}


// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// EXPORT COMPARE TABLE TO CSV
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
var _lastCompareRows = [];
var _lastCompareBrands = [];

function exportCompareCsv() {
  if (!_lastCompareRows.length || !_lastCompareBrands.length) return;
  var lines = [];
  // Header
  var header = ['Description'].concat(_lastCompareBrands.map(function(b) {
    return '"' + b.replace(/"/g, '""') + '"';
  }));
  lines.push(header.join(','));
  // Rows
  _lastCompareRows.forEach(function(row) {
    var cols = ['"' + (row.description || row.category || '').replace(/"/g, '""') + '"'];
    _lastCompareBrands.forEach(function(b) {
      var val = row[b] || '';
      cols.push('"' + val.replace(/"/g, '""') + '"');
    });
    lines.push(cols.join(','));
  });
  var csv = lines.join('\n');
  var blob = new Blob([csv], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
  var url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  var a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = url;
  a.download = 'xref-compare-' + (selectedCat || 'export').replace(/[^a-z0-9]/gi, '-').toLowerCase() + '.csv';
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  document.body.removeChild(a);
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
}

document.getElementById('exportCsvBtn').addEventListener('click', exportCompareCsv);

</script>

html, body {
  background: var(--bg);
  color: var(--text);
  font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
  font-size: 14px;
  min-height: 100vh;
}

/* ── LAYOUT ── */
.container { max-width: 1100px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 20px 80px; }

/* ── HEADER ── */
header {
  padding: 40px 0 32px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  margin-bottom: 32px;
}
.header-inner { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: space-between; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 16px; }
.logo-group {}
.eyebrow { font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .2em; color: var(--accent); text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 6px; }
h1 { font-family: 'Syne', sans-serif; font-size: 38px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1; color: var(--text); }
h1 span { color: var(--accent); }
.stat-pills { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.pill {
  font-size: 11px; padding: 5px 12px; border-radius: 20px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border2); background: var(--surface2);
  color: var(--muted); letter-spacing: .05em;
}
.pill strong { color: var(--accent); font-weight: 500; }

/* ── SEARCH ── */
.search-zone { margin-bottom: 12px; }
.search-label { font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .15em; color: var(--muted); text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 10px; }
.search-wrapper {
  position: relative;
  display: flex; align-items: center;
}
.search-icon {
  position: absolute; left: 16px;
  font-size: 20px; color: var(--muted2); pointer-events: none; line-height: 1;
}
#searchInput {
  width: 100%; padding: 16px 48px 16px 48px;
  background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--border2);

  font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; font-size: 18px;
  outline: none; transition: border-color .2s, box-shadow .2s;
}
#searchInput:focus {
  border-color: var(--accent);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.12);
}
#searchInput::placeholder { color: var(--muted2); }
.clear-btn {
  position: absolute; right: 14px;

.clear-btn:hover { color: var(--text); }

@keyframes fadeUp {

.brand-cell:hover { border-color: var(--border2); }

/* ── TABS ── */
.tab-bar {
  display: flex; gap: 4px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  margin-bottom: 28px; margin-top: -8px;
}
.tab-btn {
  font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: .06em;
  padding: 10px 20px; background: none; border: none;
  border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; color: var(--muted);
  cursor: pointer; transition: all .15s; margin-bottom: -1px;
}
.tab-btn:hover { color: var(--text); }
.tab-btn.active { color: var(--accent); border-bottom-color: var(--accent); }

.tab-pane { display: none; }
.tab-pane.active { display: block; }

/* ── COMPARE TAB ── */
.compare-controls {
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px;
  margin-bottom: 24px;
}
.compare-label {
  font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .15em; color: var(--muted);
  text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 6px;
}
#catSelect {
  width: 100%; max-width: 420px;
  padding: 10px 14px; background: var(--surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--border2); border-radius: var(--radius);
  color: var(--text); font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; font-size: 13px;
  outline: none; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color .2s;
}
#catSelect:focus { border-color: var(--accent); }

.brand-chips {
  display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; align-items: center;
}
.chip {
  font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px;
  padding: 4px 11px; border-radius: 20px; cursor: pointer;
  border: 1px solid var(--border2); background: var(--surface2);
  color: var(--muted); transition: all .12s; user-select: none;
}
.chip:hover { border-color: var(--border2); color: var(--text); }
.chip.selected {
  background: rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.12);
  border-color: rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.45);
  color: var(--accent);
}
.chip-action {
  font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px;
  padding: 4px 11px; border-radius: 20px; cursor: pointer;
  border: 1px solid var(--border); background: none;
  color: var(--muted2); transition: all .12s;
}
.chip-action:hover { color: var(--text); border-color: var(--border2); }

/* ── COMPARE TABLE ── */
.compare-meta {
  font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 10px;
  min-height: 18px;
}
.compare-meta strong { color: var(--accent); }

.compare-prompt {
  text-align: center; padding: 48px 20px;
  font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted2);
}
.compare-prompt .prompt-icon { font-size: 36px; opacity: .25; margin-bottom: 12px; }

.table-wrap { overflow-x: auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch; }

.compare-table {
  width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse;
  font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px;
}
.compare-table th {
  padding: 10px 12px; text-align: left;
  background: var(--surface2); border: 1px solid var(--border);
  font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--muted); white-space: nowrap; position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 2;
}
.compare-table th.desc-col {
  min-width: 200px; color: var(--muted);
}
.compare-table th.brand-col { min-width: 130px; }
.compare-table td {
  padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border);
  vertical-align: top; line-height: 1.5;
}
.compare-table tr:hover td { background: var(--surface2); }
.compare-table td.desc-cell {
  color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; max-width: 220px;
}
.compare-table td.empty-cell {
  color: var(--muted2); text-align: center; font-size: 13px;
}
.compare-table td.has-cell { color: var(--text); }

.model-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; }
.model-entry {
  font-size: 11px; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 3px;
  background: var(--bg); border: 1px solid var(--border);
  color: var(--text); white-space: nowrap; display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center; gap: 5px;
  cursor: pointer; transition: all .1s;
}
.model-entry:hover { background: rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.1); border-color: rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.4); }
.model-entry.copied { background: var(--accent3); color: #fff; border-color: var(--accent3); }
.model-entry-copy {
  font-size: 10px; padding: 0 3px; border-radius: 2px;
  background: var(--surface2); border: 1px solid var(--border2);
  color: var(--muted); opacity: 0; transition: opacity .1s; cursor: pointer;
}
.model-entry:hover .model-entry-copy { opacity: 1; }
.model-entry-copy:hover { background: var(--accent2); color: #fff; border-color: var(--accent2); }

@media (prefers-color-scheme: light) {
  .chip.selected {
    background: rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.1);
    border-color: rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.4);
  }
}


/* ── SEARCH HISTORY ── */
.history-bar {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap;
  min-height: 28px; margin-top: 10px;
}
.history-label {
  font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .1em; color: var(--muted2);
  text-transform: uppercase; flex-shrink: 0;
}
.history-chip {
  font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px;
  padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer;
  border: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--surface2);
  color: var(--muted); transition: all .12s; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px;
}
.history-chip:hover { border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent); background: rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.07); }
.history-chip-del {
  font-size: 10px; color: var(--muted2); line-height: 1;
  padding: 0 2px; border-radius: 2px; cursor: pointer;
}
.history-chip-del:hover { color: #ef4444; }
.history-clear {
  font-size: 10px; color: var(--muted2); cursor: pointer;
  background: none; border: none; font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
  padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px; margin-left: auto;
}
.history-clear:hover { color: var(--text); }

/* ── DID YOU MEAN ── */
.did-you-mean {
  text-align: center; padding: 24px 20px 16px;
}
.dym-title { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 10px; }
.dym-suggestions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; justify-content: center; }
.dym-chip {
  font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px;
  padding: 5px 14px; border-radius: 20px; cursor: pointer;
  border: 1px solid rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.4);
  background: rgba(var(--accent-rgb),.07); color: var(--accent);
  transition: all .12s;
}
.dym-chip:hover { background: var(--accent); color: var(--bg); }

/* ── EXPORT BUTTON ── */
.compare-actions {
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
  flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 10px;
}
.export-btn {
  font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px;
  padding: 5px 14px; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer;
  background: var(--surface2); color: var(--muted);
  border: 1px solid var(--border2); transition: all .15s;
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
}
.export-btn:hover { background: var(--accent3); color: #fff; border-color: var(--accent3); }

</style>
</head>

      <div class="compare-meta" id="compareMeta"></div>

      <div class="compare-prompt">
        <div class="prompt-icon">⊞</div>

      </div>
    </div>
  </div>


</div>

// ── SEARCH INDEX ──
function buildIndex() {
  var idx = new Map();
  function addKey(key, ri) {
    if (!key) return;
    if (!idx.has(key)) idx.set(key, new Set());
    idx.get(key).add(ri);
  }
  DB.data.forEach(function(row, ri) {
    BRANDS.forEach(function(b) {
      if (!row[b]) return;
      // Split on both / and , to get individual tokens
      row[b].split(/[\/,]/).forEach(function(m) {
        var key = norm(m.trim());
        addKey(key, ri);
      });
    });
    // Also index description
    if (row.description) {
      addKey(norm(row.description), ri);
    }
  });
  return idx;
}
var IDX = buildIndex();

function norm(s) { return s.toLowerCase().replace(/[\s\-_\/]+/g, ''); }

// ── CAT CLASS ──
function catClass(cat) {
  var c = cat.toLowerCase();
  if (c.includes('grd')) return 'cat-GRD';
  if (c.includes('diffuser')) return 'cat-Diffusers';
  if (c.includes('grille') || c.includes('register')) return 'cat-Grilles';
  if (c.includes('beam')) return 'cat-Beams';
  if (c.includes('critical')) return 'cat-Critical';
  if (c.includes('displacement') || c.includes('underfloor')) return 'cat-Displacement';
  if (c.includes('vav')) return 'cat-VAV';
  if (c.includes('terminal')) return 'cat-Terminal';
  if (c.includes('fan') || c.includes('blower') || c.includes('exhaust') ||
      c.includes('propeller') || c.includes('ventilator') || c.includes('kitchen') ||
      c.includes('lab') || c.includes('bathroom') || c.includes('tunnel') ||
      c.includes('gravity') || c.includes('power') || c.includes('plenum') ||
      c.includes('inline') || c.includes('axial') || c.includes('utility') ||
      c.includes('hooded') || c.includes('centrifugal') || c.includes('supply')) return 'cat-Fan';
  if (c.includes('damper') || c.includes('smoke') || c.includes('fire')) return 'cat-Damper';
  if (c.includes('louver') || c.includes('penthouse')) return 'cat-Louver';
  if (c.includes('coil')) return 'cat-Coil';
  return 'cat-Other';
}

// ── HIGHLIGHT ──
function esc(s) {
  return s.replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/</g,'<').replace(/>/g,'>');
}
function highlight(text, query) {
  if (!query) return esc(text);
  var escaped = esc(text);
  var nq = norm(query);
  if (!nq) return escaped;
  try {
    var re = new RegExp(nq.split('').join('[\\s\\-_]*'), 'gi');
    return escaped.replace(re, function(m){ return '<mark>' + m + '</mark>'; });
  } catch(e) { return escaped; }
}

function renderCard(row, query, delay) {

  hdr.className = 'card-header';

  badge.textContent = row.category;

  var desc = document.createElement('span');
  desc.className = 'card-desc';
  var descText = row.description || '';
  if (descText) {
    desc.innerHTML = highlight(descText, query);
  } else {
    // Collect all models from this row that match the query, show them as the title
    var matchedModels = [];
    BRANDS.forEach(function(b) {
      if (!row[b]) return;
      row[b].split(/[\/,]/).forEach(function(m) {
        m = m.trim();
        if (m && norm(m) === nq) matchedModels.push(b + ': ' + m);
      });
    });
    if (matchedModels.length > 0) {
      desc.innerHTML = '<span style="color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;font-weight:400">' + esc(matchedModels.join(' · ')) + '</span>';
    } else {
      desc.innerHTML = '<span style="color:var(--muted2);font-size:11px;font-weight:400">Cross-reference group</span>';
    }
  }

  // Count brands with data
  var matchedBrands = BRANDS.filter(function(b){ return row[b]; });
  var summary = document.createElement('span');
  summary.className = 'card-summary';
  summary.textContent = matchedBrands.length + ' brand' + (matchedBrands.length !== 1 ? 's' : '');

  var chev = document.createElement('span');
  chev.className = 'card-chevron';
  chev.textContent = '▼';

  hdr.appendChild(badge);
  hdr.appendChild(desc);
  hdr.appendChild(summary);
  hdr.appendChild(chev);
  hdr.addEventListener('click', function(){ toggleCard(card); });
  card.appendChild(hdr);

  // Body
  var body = document.createElement('div');
  body.className = 'card-body';

  var grid = document.createElement('div');
  grid.className = 'brand-grid';

  // Matched brand on top, rest alphabetical
  // Check exact match first, fall back to prefix match
  var sortedBrands = BRANDS.slice().sort(function(a, b) {
    var aHas = !!row[a], bHas = !!row[b];
    if (!aHas && !bHas) return 0;
    if (!aHas) return 1;
    if (!bHas) return -1;
    var aExact = nq && row[a].split(/[\/,]/).some(function(m){ return norm(m.trim()) === nq; });
    var bExact = nq && row[b].split(/[\/,]/).some(function(m){ return norm(m.trim()) === nq; });
    if (aExact && !bExact) return -1;
    if (!aExact && bExact) return 1;
    // Fall back to prefix match (e.g. "T3SQ" matches "T3SQ-0")
    var aPrefix = nq && row[a].split(/[\/,]/).some(function(m){ return norm(m.trim()).indexOf(nq) === 0; });
    var bPrefix = nq && row[b].split(/[\/,]/).some(function(m){ return norm(m.trim()).indexOf(nq) === 0; });
    if (aPrefix && !bPrefix) return -1;
    if (!aPrefix && bPrefix) return 1;
    return a.localeCompare(b);
  });

  sortedBrands.forEach(function(brand) {
    if (!row[brand]) return;
    var brandIdx = BRANDS.indexOf(brand);
    var cell = document.createElement('div');
    cell.className = 'brand-cell bc' + (brandIdx % 51);

    var nameEl = document.createElement('div');
    nameEl.className = 'brand-name';
    nameEl.textContent = brand;

    var modelsEl = document.createElement('div');
    modelsEl.className = 'brand-models';

    // Split on comma only — preserve slashes within model names (e.g. "w/SRA")
    var models = [];
    row[brand].split(',').forEach(function(m) {
      m = m.trim();
      if (m) models.push(m);
    });

    models.forEach(function(m) {
      var tag = document.createElement('div');
      tag.className = 'model-tag';
      // Main label
      var label = document.createElement('span');
      label.className = 'model-tag-text';
      label.innerHTML = highlight(m, query);
      // Copy button
      var copyBtn = document.createElement('span');
      copyBtn.className = 'model-tag-copy';
      copyBtn.textContent = '⎘';
      copyBtn.title = 'Copy ' + brand + ': ' + m;
      copyBtn.addEventListener('click', function(e){
        e.stopPropagation();
        copyModelText(m, brand, copyBtn);
      });
      tag.appendChild(label);
      tag.appendChild(copyBtn);
      // Click tag = Google search
      tag.addEventListener('click', function(e){ e.stopPropagation(); googleSearch(m, brand); });
      modelsEl.appendChild(tag);
    });

    cell.appendChild(nameEl);
    cell.appendChild(modelsEl);
    grid.appendChild(cell);
  });

  body.appendChild(grid);
  card.appendChild(body);
  return card;
}

// FUZZY DID YOU MEAN
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
function levenshtein(a, b) {
  var m = a.length, n = b.length;
  var dp = [];
  for (var i = 0; i <= m; i++) { dp[i] = [i]; }
  for (var j = 0; j <= n; j++) { dp[0][j] = j; }
  for (var i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
    for (var j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
      dp[i][j] = a[i-1] === b[j-1]
        ? dp[i-1][j-1]
        : 1 + Math.min(dp[i-1][j], dp[i][j-1], dp[i-1][j-1]);
    }
  }
  return dp[m][n];
}

function findSuggestions(query) {
  var nq = norm(query);
  if (nq.length < 2) return [];
  // Collect all unique model tokens from index
  var candidates = [];
  IDX.forEach(function(_, key) {
    if (Math.abs(key.length - nq.length) <= 3) {
      candidates.push(key);
    }
  });
  // Score by levenshtein distance
  var scored = candidates.map(function(c) {
    return { key: c, dist: levenshtein(nq, c) };
  }).filter(function(s) {
    // Allow up to 2 edits, or 30% of query length
    return s.dist <= Math.max(2, Math.floor(nq.length * 0.35)) && s.dist > 0;
  }).sort(function(a, b) { return a.dist - b.dist; });

  // Return top 5 unique original model strings
  var seen = new Set();
  var results = [];
  for (var i = 0; i < scored.length && results.length < 5; i++) {
    var key = scored[i].key;
    // Find original model string for this key
    var found = false;
    DB.data.forEach(function(row) {
      if (found) return;
      BRANDS.forEach(function(b) {
        if (!row[b] || found) return;
        row[b].split(/[,\/]/).forEach(function(m) {
          m = m.trim();
          if (norm(m) === key && !seen.has(m)) {
            seen.add(m);
            results.push(m);
            found = true;
          }
        });
      });
    });
  }
  return results;
}

function doSearch() {
  var query = document.getElementById('searchInput').value.trim();
  var results = document.getElementById('results');
  document.getElementById('clearBtn').style.display = query ? 'block' : 'none';

  if (!query) {
    results.innerHTML = '';
    var ws = document.createElement('div');
    ws.className = 'welcome-state';
    ws.id = 'welcomeState';
    ws.innerHTML = '<div class="welcome-icon">⟷</div><div class="welcome-title">Cross-Reference Any Model</div><div class="welcome-sub">Type a model number above — search all AD brands simultaneously and find every equivalent.</div><div class="welcome-sub" style="margin-top:6px;font-size:11px;opacity:.6;letter-spacing:.04em;">Powered by Triune Solutions</div>';
    results.appendChild(ws);
    return;
  }

  var nq = norm(query);
  if (!nq) return;

  // Helper: does this row have an exact token match for nq?
  function rowHasExact(row) {
    return BRANDS.some(function(br) {
      if (!row[br]) return false;
      return row[br].split(/[\/,]/).some(function(m) { return norm(m.trim()) === nq; });
    }) || (row.description && norm(row.description) === nq);
  }

  // Step 1: exact token matches only
  var exactHits = new Set();
  IDX.forEach(function(rowSet, key) {
    if (key === nq) rowSet.forEach(function(ri){ exactHits.add(ri); });
  });

  // Step 2: if no exact hits, fall back to partial substring match
  var hits;
  if (exactHits.size > 0) {
    hits = exactHits;
  } else {
    hits = new Set();
    IDX.forEach(function(rowSet, key) {
      if (key.indexOf(nq) >= 0) rowSet.forEach(function(ri){ hits.add(ri); });
    });
  }

  // Apply filter
  var filtered = Array.from(hits).map(function(ri){ return DB.data[ri]; });

  // Sort: exact description first, then exact model, then partial
  filtered.sort(function(a, b) {
    var aExact = rowHasExact(a);
    var bExact = rowHasExact(b);
    if (aExact && !bExact) return -1;
    if (!aExact && bExact) return 1;
    return 0;
  });

  results.innerHTML = '';

  if (filtered.length === 0) {
    var nm = document.createElement('div');
    nm.className = 'no-match';
    nm.innerHTML = '<div class="no-match-code">404</div><p>No matches for <strong style="color:var(--text)">' + esc(query) + '</strong> across ' + BRANDS.length + ' brands.</p>';

    // Did You Mean suggestions
    var suggestions = findSuggestions(query);
    if (suggestions.length) {
      var dym = document.createElement('div');
      dym.className = 'did-you-mean';
      dym.innerHTML = '<div class="dym-title">Did you mean…</div>';
      var chips = document.createElement('div');
      chips.className = 'dym-suggestions';
      suggestions.forEach(function(s) {
        var chip = document.createElement('button');
        chip.className = 'dym-chip';
        chip.textContent = s;
        chip.addEventListener('click', function() {
          document.getElementById('searchInput').value = s;
          doSearch();
        });
        chips.appendChild(chip);
      });
      dym.appendChild(chips);
      nm.appendChild(dym);
    }

    results.appendChild(nm);
    return;
  }

  var hdr = document.createElement('div');
  hdr.className = 'match-header';

  var cnt = document.createElement('div');
  cnt.className = 'match-count';
  cnt.innerHTML = 'Found <strong>' + filtered.length + '</strong> match' + (filtered.length !== 1 ? 'es' : '') + ' for <strong style="color:var(--text)">' + esc(query) + '</strong>';

  var toggleBtn = document.createElement('button');
  toggleBtn.className = 'toggle-all-btn';
  toggleBtn.textContent = '⊟ Collapse All';
  toggleBtn.addEventListener('click', function(){ toggleAll(toggleBtn); });

  hdr.appendChild(cnt);
  hdr.appendChild(toggleBtn);
  results.appendChild(hdr);

  filtered.forEach(function(row, i) {
    results.appendChild(renderCard(row, query, i * 30));
  });

}

// Build sorted category list and brandsPerCat lookup
var CATEGORIES = [];
var brandsPerCat = {};
(function() {
  var catSet = {};
  DB.data.forEach(function(row) {
    var cat = row.category;
    if (!cat) return;
    catSet[cat] = true;
    if (!brandsPerCat[cat]) brandsPerCat[cat] = {};
    BRANDS.forEach(function(b) {
      if (row[b]) brandsPerCat[cat][b] = true;
    });
  });
  CATEGORIES = Object.keys(catSet).sort();

  // Populate category dropdown
  var sel = document.getElementById('catSelect');
  CATEGORIES.forEach(function(cat) {
    var opt = document.createElement('option');
    opt.value = cat;
    opt.textContent = cat;
    sel.appendChild(opt);
  });
})();

var selectedCat = '';
var selectedBrands = {};

function buildChips(cat) {
  var wrap = document.getElementById('brandChipsWrap');
  var container = document.getElementById('brandChips');
  var catBrands = brandsPerCat[cat] || {};
  var brandList = BRANDS.filter(function(b) { return catBrands[b]; }).sort();

  if (!brandList.length) { wrap.style.display = 'none'; return; }

  // Clear existing chips (keep action buttons)
  var chips = container.querySelectorAll('.chip');
  chips.forEach(function(c) { c.parentNode.removeChild(c); });

  // Rebuild selected state — keep previously selected brands that exist in new cat
  var newSelected = {};
  brandList.forEach(function(b) {
    if (selectedBrands[b]) newSelected[b] = true;
  });
  selectedBrands = newSelected;

  brandList.forEach(function(b) {
    var chip = document.createElement('button');
    chip.className = 'chip' + (selectedBrands[b] ? ' selected' : '');
    chip.textContent = b;
    chip.dataset.brand = b;
    chip.addEventListener('click', function() {
      if (selectedBrands[b]) {
        delete selectedBrands[b];
        chip.classList.remove('selected');
      } else {
        selectedBrands[b] = true;
        chip.classList.add('selected');
      }
      renderTable();
    });
    container.appendChild(chip);
  });

  wrap.style.display = 'block';
}

document.getElementById('selectAllChips').addEventListener('click', function() {
  if (!selectedCat) return;
  var catBrands = brandsPerCat[selectedCat] || {};
  BRANDS.filter(function(b) { return catBrands[b]; }).forEach(function(b) {
    selectedBrands[b] = true;
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('#brandChips .chip').forEach(function(c) { c.classList.add('selected'); });
  renderTable();
});

document.getElementById('clearChips').addEventListener('click', function() {
  selectedBrands = {};
  document.querySelectorAll('#brandChips .chip').forEach(function(c) { c.classList.remove('selected'); });
  renderTable();
});

document.getElementById('catSelect').addEventListener('change', function() {
  selectedCat = this.value;
  selectedBrands = {};
  buildChips(selectedCat);
  renderTable();
});

function copyCompareModel(model, brand, el) {
  var text = brand + ': ' + model;
  function done() {
    el.classList.add('copied');
    var orig = el.textContent;
    el.textContent = '✓';
    setTimeout(function() {
      el.classList.remove('copied');
      el.textContent = orig;
    }, 1200);
  }
  if (navigator.clipboard) {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(done).catch(function() {
      try { var ta = document.createElement('textarea'); ta.value = text; document.body.appendChild(ta); ta.select(); document.execCommand('copy'); document.body.removeChild(ta); done(); } catch(e) {}
    });
  } else {
    try { var ta = document.createElement('textarea'); ta.value = text; document.body.appendChild(ta); ta.select(); document.execCommand('copy'); document.body.removeChild(ta); done(); } catch(e) {}
  }
}

function renderTable() {
  var output = document.getElementById('compareOutput');
  var meta   = document.getElementById('compareMeta');

  var brands = BRANDS.filter(function(b) { return selectedBrands[b]; });

  if (!selectedCat) {
    meta.innerHTML = '';
    document.getElementById('exportCsvBtn').style.display = 'none';
    output.innerHTML = '<div class="compare-prompt"><div class="prompt-icon">⊞</div>Choose a category above to start comparing models across brands.</div>';
    return;
  }

  if (brands.length < 2) {
    meta.innerHTML = '';
    output.innerHTML = '<div class="compare-prompt"><div class="prompt-icon">↕</div>Select at least <strong>2 brands</strong> to generate a comparison table.</div>';
    return;
  }

  // Filter rows: in selected category + has at least one selected brand
  var rows = DB.data.filter(function(row) {
    if (row.category !== selectedCat) return false;
    return brands.some(function(b) { return row[b]; });
  });

  _lastCompareRows = rows;
  _lastCompareBrands = brands;
  document.getElementById('exportCsvBtn').style.display = rows.length ? 'flex' : 'none';

  meta.innerHTML = 'Showing <strong>' + rows.length + '</strong> group' + (rows.length !== 1 ? 's' : '') +
    ' across <strong>' + brands.length + '</strong> brand' + (brands.length !== 1 ? 's' : '') +
    ' in <strong>' + esc(selectedCat) + '</strong>';

  if (!rows.length) {
    output.innerHTML = '<div class="compare-prompt"><div class="prompt-icon">∅</div>No product groups found for this combination.</div>';
    return;
  }

  var html = '<div class="table-wrap"><table class="compare-table"><thead><tr>';
  html += '<th class="desc-col">Description / Group</th>';
  brands.forEach(function(b) {
    html += '<th class="brand-col">' + esc(b) + '</th>';
  });
  html += '</tr></thead><tbody>';

  rows.forEach(function(row) {
    html += '<tr>';

    // Description cell
    var descText = row.description || row.category || '';
    html += '<td class="desc-cell">' + esc(descText) + '</td>';

    // Brand cells
    brands.forEach(function(b) {
      var val = row[b] || '';
      if (!val) {
        html += '<td class="empty-cell">—</td>';
      } else {
        var models = val.split(',').map(function(m) { return m.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
        html += '<td class="has-cell"><div class="model-list">';
        models.forEach(function(m) {
          html += '<span class="model-entry" data-model="' + esc(m) + '" data-brand="' + esc(b) + '">' +
            '<span class="model-entry-text">' + esc(m) + '</span>' +
            '<span class="model-entry-copy" title="Copy ' + esc(b) + ': ' + esc(m) + '">⎘</span>' +
            '</span>';
        });
        html += '</div></td>';
      }
    });

    html += '</tr>';
  });

  html += '</tbody></table></div>';
  output.innerHTML = html;

  // Attach copy handlers
  output.querySelectorAll('.model-entry').forEach(function(el) {
    // Click entry = Google search
    el.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      if (e.target.classList.contains('model-entry-copy')) return;
      googleSearch(el.dataset.model, el.dataset.brand);
    });
    // Click copy icon = copy to clipboard
    var copyBtn = el.querySelector('.model-entry-copy');
    if (copyBtn) {
      copyBtn.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        e.stopPropagation();
        copyModelText(el.dataset.model, el.dataset.brand, copyBtn);
      });
    }
  });
}

// EXPORT COMPARE TABLE TO CSV
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
var _lastCompareRows = [];
var _lastCompareBrands = [];

function exportCompareCsv() {
  if (!_lastCompareRows.length || !_lastCompareBrands.length) return;
  var lines = [];
  // Header
  var header = ['Description'].concat(_lastCompareBrands.map(function(b) {
    return '"' + b.replace(/"/g, '""') + '"';
  }));
  lines.push(header.join(','));
  // Rows
  _lastCompareRows.forEach(function(row) {
    var cols = ['"' + (row.description || row.category || '').replace(/"/g, '""') + '"'];
    _lastCompareBrands.forEach(function(b) {
      var val = row[b] || '';
      cols.push('"' + val.replace(/"/g, '""') + '"');
    });
    lines.push(cols.join(','));
  });
  var csv = lines.join('\n');
  var blob = new Blob([csv], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
  var url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  var a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = url;
  a.download = 'xref-compare-' + (selectedCat || 'export').replace(/[^a-z0-9]/gi, '-').toLowerCase() + '.csv';
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  document.body.removeChild(a);
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
}

document.getElementById('exportCsvBtn').addEventListener('click', exportCompareCsv);

Here's what I've done for both sites. Here's the complete summary:

---

## What Was Added

### For BOTH `triune_map` (atlas) AND `triune_visualizer` (x-ref):

**1. `middleware.js` — Vercel Edge Middleware**
- Rate limiting: 60 requests/minute per IP
- Bot detection: blocks 24+ known scraper user-agents (curl, wget, python-requests, scrapy, puppeteer, selenium, etc.)
- Blocks requests with no user-agent
- Honeypot trap: visiting `/.secret-data` or `/.admin` auto-bans that IP
- Security headers added to every response

**2. `vercel.json` — Updated with security headers**
- `X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow, noarchive`
- `X-Frame-Options: DENY` (prevents embedding in iframes)
- `Cache-Control: no-store` (prevents caching)
- `Referrer-Policy: no-referrer`

**3. `robots.txt` — Blocks all crawlers**
- `Disallow: /` for all user-agents

**4. `package.json` — Required for middleware**

**5. HTML meta tags added:**
- `<meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow, noarchive, nosnippet">`
- `<meta name="googlebot" content="noindex, nofollow">`

**6. Client-side JavaScript protections:**
- Right-click disabled
- DevTools detection (blanks page if detected)
- Keyboard shortcuts blocked (F12, Ctrl+U, Ctrl+Shift+I)
- Text selection disabled on data elements
- Drag disabled
- Hidden honeypot link that traps bots

---

## To Deploy

For each project, just push to Vercel as normal:

```bash
cd C:\Users\JFL\Documents\vercel\triune_map
vercel --prod

cd C:\Users\JFL\Documents\vercel\triune_visualizer
vercel --prod
```

---

## What's Still Remaining (Phase 2)

Task #2 — **Move data to server-side APIs** — this is the big one. Right now all your data is still embedded in the HTML. The middleware stops casual scrapers, but a determined person can still:
1. Open the site in a normal browser

content.text:
Here's exactly what's live right now on your sites:

## What's Implemented

### 1. Edge Middleware (server-side, runs before page loads)
- **Bot User-Agent Blocking** — blocks 24+ known scrapers: `curl`, `wget`, `python-requests`, `scrapy`, `puppeteer`, `playwright`, `selenium`, `axios`, `node-fetch`, `go-http-client`, headless browsers, etc.
- **No User-Agent = Blocked** — requests without a user-agent get 403
- **Rate Limiting** — 60 requests/minute per IP, then 429 Too Many Requests
- **Honeypot Trap** — hidden link to `/.secret-data`, any IP that visits it gets permanently banned

### 2. Security Headers (on every response)
- `X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow` — tells search engines not to index
- `X-Frame-Options: DENY` — prevents embedding your site in iframes
- `Cache-Control: no-store` — prevents caching/archiving your pages
- `Referrer-Policy: no-referrer` — hides where users came from

### 3. Client-Side JS Protections
- Right-click disabled
- F12 / Ctrl+U / Ctrl+Shift+I blocked (devtools shortcuts)
- Ctrl+S blocked (save page)
- Drag disabled
- Text selection disabled on data elements
- DevTools detection — if devtools opens, page content is replaced with "Access restricted"

### 4. Crawl Prevention
- `robots.txt` — `Disallow: /` for all bots
- `<meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow">` in HTML

---

## What's NOT Implemented Yet (Phase 2)

- **Data is still embedded in the HTML source**. A person who opens your site in a normal browser can still:
  - View Page Source and copy the data
  - Use the browser console to type `TITUS_REPS` or `DB` and get everything
  - Disable JavaScript and just read the raw HTML

Phase 2 would move all the data behind server-side API endpoints so it's never in the page source at all. Want me to start that?
