<script>
// --- Anti-scraping measures ---
// Disable right-click context menu
document.addEventListener('contextmenu', function(e) { e.preventDefault(); });

// Detect DevTools open (basic deterrent)
(function() {
  const threshold = 160;
  const check = function() {
    if (window.outerWidth - window.innerWidth > threshold ||
        window.outerHeight - window.innerHeight > threshold) {
      document.body.innerHTML = '<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:100vh;background:#07090e;color:#ff3c50;font-family:sans-serif;font-size:24px;text-align:center;padding:40px">Access restricted. Developer tools detected.</div>';
    }
  };
  setInterval(check, 2000);
})();

// Disable text selection on data elements
document.querySelectorAll('.brand-cell, .model-tag, .card').forEach(function(el) {
  el.style.userSelect = 'none';
  el.style.webkitUserSelect = 'none';
});

// Disable drag
document.addEventListener('dragstart', function(e) { e.preventDefault(); });

// Disable Ctrl+S, Ctrl+U (view source), Ctrl+Shift+I (devtools)
document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
  if (e.ctrlKey && (e.key === 's' || e.key === 'u' || e.key === 'S' || e.key === 'U')) {
    e.preventDefault();
  }
  if (e.ctrlKey && e.shiftKey && (e.key === 'I' || e.key === 'i' || e.key === 'J' || e.key === 'j' || e.key === 'C' || e.key === 'c')) {
    e.preventDefault();
  }
  if (e.key === 'F12') {
    e.preventDefault();
  }
});
</script>

<script>
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════
// TRIUNE X-REF — API-based frontend (no inline data)
// ══════════════════════════════════════════════

var BRANDS = [];
var CATEGORIES = [];
var debounceTimer = null;
var brandsPerCat = {};
var selectedCat = '';
var selectedBrands = {};
var _lastCompareRows = [];
var _lastCompareBrands = [];

// ── INIT: Load metadata from API ──
(async function init() {
  try {
    var resp = await fetch('/api/meta');
    var meta = await resp.json();
    BRANDS = meta.brands;
    CATEGORIES = meta.categories;
    document.getElementById('modelCount').textContent = meta.modelCount.toLocaleString();

    // Populate category dropdown
    var sel = document.getElementById('catSelect');
    CATEGORIES.forEach(function(cat) {
      var opt = document.createElement('option');
      opt.value = cat;
      opt.textContent = cat;
      sel.appendChild(opt);
    });
  } catch(e) {
    console.error('Failed to load metadata:', e);
  }
})();

// ── HELPERS ──
function norm(s) { return s.toLowerCase().replace(/[\s\-_\/]+/g, ''); }

function catClass(cat) {
  var c = cat.toLowerCase();
  if (c.includes('grd')) return 'cat-GRD';
  if (c.includes('diffuser')) return 'cat-Diffusers';
  if (c.includes('grille') || c.includes('register')) return 'cat-Grilles';
  if (c.includes('beam')) return 'cat-Beams';
  if (c.includes('critical')) return 'cat-Critical';
  if (c.includes('displacement') || c.includes('underfloor')) return 'cat-Displacement';
  if (c.includes('vav')) return 'cat-VAV';
  if (c.includes('terminal')) return 'cat-Terminal';
  if (c.includes('fan') || c.includes('blower') || c.includes('exhaust') ||
      c.includes('propeller') || c.includes('ventilator') || c.includes('kitchen') ||
      c.includes('lab') || c.includes('bathroom') || c.includes('tunnel') ||
      c.includes('gravity') || c.includes('power') || c.includes('plenum') ||
      c.includes('inline') || c.includes('axial') || c.includes('utility') ||
      c.includes('hooded') || c.includes('centrifugal') || c.includes('supply')) return 'cat-Fan';
  if (c.includes('damper') || c.includes('smoke') || c.includes('fire')) return 'cat-Damper';
  if (c.includes('louver') || c.includes('penthouse')) return 'cat-Louver';
  if (c.includes('coil')) return 'cat-Coil';
  return 'cat-Other';
}

function esc(s) {
  return s.replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/</g,'<').replace(/>/g,'>');
}

function highlight(text, query) {
  if (!query) return esc(text);
  var escaped = esc(text);
  var nq = norm(query);
  if (!nq) return escaped;
  try {
    var re = new RegExp(nq.split('').join('[\\s\\-_]*'), 'gi');
    return escaped.replace(re, function(m){ return '<mark>' + m + '</mark>'; });
  } catch(e) { return escaped; }
}

function googleSearch(model, brand) {
  var clean = model.replace(/<[^>]+>/g,'');
  var query = encodeURIComponent(brand + ' ' + clean);
  window.open('https://www.google.com/search?q=' + query, '_blank', 'noopener');
}

function copyModelText(model, brand, el) {
  var clean = model.replace(/<[^>]+>/g,'');
  var toCopy = brand + ': ' + clean;
  var origHTML = el.innerHTML;
  el.classList.add('copied');
  el.textContent = '\u2713';
  setTimeout(function(){
    el.classList.remove('copied');
    el.innerHTML = origHTML;
  }, 1200);
  if (navigator.clipboard) {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(toCopy).catch(function(){
      try { var ta=document.createElement('textarea'); ta.value=toCopy; document.body.appendChild(ta); ta.select(); document.execCommand('copy'); document.body.removeChild(ta); } catch(e){}
    });
  } else {
    try { var ta=document.createElement('textarea'); ta.value=toCopy; document.body.appendChild(ta); ta.select(); document.execCommand('copy'); document.body.removeChild(ta); } catch(e){}
  }
}
function copyModel(model, brand, el) { copyModelText(model, brand, el); }

// ── RENDER CARD (from API result) ──
function renderCard(item, query, delay) {
  var card = document.createElement('div');
  card.className = 'card open';
  card.style.animationDelay = Math.min(delay, 300) + 'ms';
  var nq = norm(query);

  var hdr = document.createElement('div');
  hdr.className = 'card-header';

  var badge = document.createElement('span');
  badge.className = 'cat-badge ' + catClass(item.category);
  badge.textContent = item.category;

  var desc = document.createElement('span');
  desc.className = 'card-desc';
  var descText = item.description || '';
  if (descText) {
    desc.innerHTML = highlight(descText, query);
  } else {
    desc.innerHTML = '<span style="color:var(--muted2);font-size:11px;font-weight:400">Cross-reference group</span>';
  }

  var brandKeys = Object.keys(item.brands);
  var summary = document.createElement('span');
  summary.className = 'card-summary';
  summary.textContent = brandKeys.length + ' brand' + (brandKeys.length !== 1 ? 's' : '');

  var chev = document.createElement('span');
  chev.className = 'card-chevron';
  chev.textContent = '\u25BC';

  hdr.appendChild(badge);
  hdr.appendChild(desc);
  hdr.appendChild(summary);
  hdr.appendChild(chev);
  hdr.addEventListener('click', function(){ toggleCard(card); });
  card.appendChild(hdr);

  var body = document.createElement('div');
  body.className = 'card-body';

  var grid = document.createElement('div');
  grid.className = 'brand-grid';

  // Sort brands: exact match first, then alphabetical
  var sortedBrands = brandKeys.slice().sort(function(a, b) {
    var aExact = nq && item.brands[a].split(/[\/,]/).some(function(m){ return norm(m.trim()) === nq; });
    var bExact = nq && item.brands[b].split(/[\/,]/).some(function(m){ return norm(m.trim()) === nq; });
    if (aExact && !bExact) return -1;
    if (!aExact && bExact) return 1;
    var aPrefix = nq && item.brands[a].split(/[\/,]/).some(function(m){ return norm(m.trim()).indexOf(nq) === 0; });
    var bPrefix = nq && item.brands[b].split(/[\/,]/).some(function(m){ return norm(m.trim()).indexOf(nq) === 0; });
    if (aPrefix && !bPrefix) return -1;
    if (!aPrefix && bPrefix) return 1;
    return a.localeCompare(b);
  });

  sortedBrands.forEach(function(brand) {
    var brandIdx = BRANDS.indexOf(brand);
    var cell = document.createElement('div');
    cell.className = 'brand-cell bc' + (brandIdx % 51);

    var nameEl = document.createElement('div');
    nameEl.className = 'brand-name';
    nameEl.textContent = brand;

    var modelsEl = document.createElement('div');
    modelsEl.className = 'brand-models';

    var models = item.brands[brand].split(',').map(function(m) { return m.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);

    models.forEach(function(m) {
      var tag = document.createElement('div');
      tag.className = 'model-tag';
      var label = document.createElement('span');
      label.className = 'model-tag-text';
      label.innerHTML = highlight(m, query);
      var copyBtn = document.createElement('span');
      copyBtn.className = 'model-tag-copy';
      copyBtn.textContent = '\u2398';
      copyBtn.title = 'Copy ' + brand + ': ' + m;
      copyBtn.addEventListener('click', function(e){
        e.stopPropagation();
        copyModelText(m, brand, copyBtn);
      });
      tag.appendChild(label);
      tag.appendChild(copyBtn);
      tag.addEventListener('click', function(e){ e.stopPropagation(); googleSearch(m, brand); });
      modelsEl.appendChild(tag);
    });

    cell.appendChild(nameEl);
    cell.appendChild(modelsEl);
    grid.appendChild(cell);
  });

  body.appendChild(grid);
  card.appendChild(body);
  return card;
}

function toggleCard(card) { card.classList.toggle('open'); }
function toggleAll(btn) {
  var cards = document.querySelectorAll('.card');
  var anyOpen = Array.from(cards).some(function(c){ return c.classList.contains('open'); });
  cards.forEach(function(c){ anyOpen ? c.classList.remove('open') : c.classList.add('open'); });
  btn.textContent = anyOpen ? '\u229E Expand All' : '\u229F Collapse All';
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════
// SEARCH HISTORY
// ══════════════════════════════════════
var HISTORY_KEY = 'xref_search_history';
var MAX_HISTORY = 10;

function loadHistory() {
  try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(HISTORY_KEY) || '[]'); } catch(e) { return []; }
}
function saveHistory(arr) {
  try { localStorage.setItem(HISTORY_KEY, JSON.stringify(arr)); } catch(e) {}
}
function addToHistory(query) {
  if (!query || query.length < 2) return;
  var hist = loadHistory();
  hist = hist.filter(function(h) { return h.toLowerCase() !== query.toLowerCase(); });
  hist.unshift(query);
  if (hist.length > MAX_HISTORY) hist = hist.slice(0, MAX_HISTORY);
  saveHistory(hist);
  renderHistory();
}
function removeFromHistory(query) {
  var hist = loadHistory().filter(function(h) { return h !== query; });
  saveHistory(hist);
  renderHistory();
}
function renderHistory() {
  var hist = loadHistory();
  var bar  = document.getElementById('historyBar');
  var wrap = document.getElementById('historyChips');
  if (!hist.length) { bar.style.display = 'none'; return; }
  bar.style.display = 'flex';
  wrap.innerHTML = '';
  hist.forEach(function(q) {
    var chip = document.createElement('span');
    chip.className = 'history-chip';
    var label = document.createElement('span');
    label.textContent = q;
    label.addEventListener('click', function() {
      document.getElementById('searchInput').value = q;
      doSearch();
    });
    var del = document.createElement('span');
    del.className = 'history-chip-del';
    del.textContent = '\u2715';
    del.title = 'Remove';
    del.addEventListener('click', function(e) { e.stopPropagation(); removeFromHistory(q); });
    chip.appendChild(label);
    chip.appendChild(del);
    wrap.appendChild(chip);
  });
}
document.getElementById('historyClear').addEventListener('click', function() {
  saveHistory([]);
  renderHistory();
});
renderHistory();

// ══════════════════════════════════════
// SEARCH (API-based)
// ══════════════════════════════════════
var searchController = null;

async function doSearch() {
  var query = document.getElementById('searchInput').value.trim();
  var results = document.getElementById('results');
  document.getElementById('clearBtn').style.display = query ? 'block' : 'none';

  if (!query) {
    results.innerHTML = '';
    var ws = document.createElement('div');
    ws.className = 'welcome-state';
    ws.id = 'welcomeState';
    ws.innerHTML = '<div class="welcome-icon">\u27F7</div><div class="welcome-title">Cross-Reference Any Model</div><div class="welcome-sub">Type a model number above \u2014 search all AD brands simultaneously and find every equivalent.</div><div class="welcome-sub" style="margin-top:6px;font-size:11px;opacity:.6;letter-spacing:.04em;">Powered by Triune Solutions</div>';
    results.appendChild(ws);
    return;
  }

  if (query.length < 2) return;

  // Cancel previous request
  if (searchController) searchController.abort();
  searchController = new AbortController();

  try {
    var resp = await fetch('/api/search?q=' + encodeURIComponent(query), {
      signal: searchController.signal
    });
    var data = await resp.json();

    if (data.error) {
      results.innerHTML = '';
      return;
    }

    results.innerHTML = '';

    if (data.results.length === 0) {
      var nm = document.createElement('div');
      nm.className = 'no-match';
      nm.innerHTML = '<div class="no-match-code">404</div><p>No matches for <strong style="color:var(--text)">' + esc(query) + '</strong> across ' + BRANDS.length + ' brands.</p>';
      results.appendChild(nm);
      return;
    }

    var hdr = document.createElement('div');
    hdr.className = 'match-header';

    var cnt = document.createElement('div');
    cnt.className = 'match-count';
    cnt.innerHTML = 'Found <strong>' + data.total + '</strong> match' + (data.total !== 1 ? 'es' : '') + ' for <strong style="color:var(--text)">' + esc(query) + '</strong>' + (data.total > data.showing ? ' (showing ' + data.showing + ')' : '');

    var toggleBtn = document.createElement('button');
    toggleBtn.className = 'toggle-all-btn';
    toggleBtn.textContent = '\u229F Collapse All';
    toggleBtn.addEventListener('click', function(){ toggleAll(toggleBtn); });

    hdr.appendChild(cnt);
    hdr.appendChild(toggleBtn);
    results.appendChild(hdr);

    data.results.forEach(function(item, i) {
      results.appendChild(renderCard(item, query, i * 30));
    });

  } catch(e) {
    if (e.name === 'AbortError') return; // cancelled, ignore
    console.error('Search error:', e);
  }
}

// ── INPUT ──
var historyTimer = null;
document.getElementById('searchInput').addEventListener('input', function() {
  clearTimeout(debounceTimer);
  debounceTimer = setTimeout(doSearch, 250);
  clearTimeout(historyTimer);
  var q = this.value.trim();
  if (q.length >= 2) {
    historyTimer = setTimeout(function() { addToHistory(q); }, 5000);
  }
});
document.getElementById('searchInput').addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
  if (e.key === 'Escape') { this.value = ''; doSearch(); }
  if (e.key === 'Enter') {
    clearTimeout(debounceTimer);
    clearTimeout(historyTimer);
    doSearch();
    var q = this.value.trim();
    if (q.length >= 2) addToHistory(q);
  }
});
document.getElementById('clearBtn').addEventListener('click', function() {
  document.getElementById('searchInput').value = '';
  doSearch();
  document.getElementById('searchInput').focus();
});

// ══════════════════════════════════════
// TAB SWITCHING
// ══════════════════════════════════════
document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(function(btn) {
  btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(function(b) { b.classList.remove('active'); });
    document.querySelectorAll('.tab-pane').forEach(function(p) { p.classList.remove('active'); });
    btn.classList.add('active');
    document.getElementById('tab-' + btn.dataset.tab).classList.add('active');
  });
});

// ══════════════════════════════════════
// COMPARE TAB (API-based)
// ══════════════════════════════════════

function buildChips(cat) {
  var wrap = document.getElementById('brandChipsWrap');
  var container = document.getElementById('brandChips');

  // Fetch compare data to know which brands have data for this category
  fetch('/api/compare?category=' + encodeURIComponent(cat))
    .then(function(r) { return r.json(); })
    .then(function(data) {
      // Find which brands appear in results
      var catBrands = {};
      data.results.forEach(function(row) {
        Object.keys(row.brands).forEach(function(b) { catBrands[b] = true; });
      });

      // Also store for brandsPerCat
      brandsPerCat[cat] = catBrands;

      var brandList = BRANDS.filter(function(b) { return catBrands[b]; }).sort();
      if (!brandList.length) { wrap.style.display = 'none'; return; }

      var chips = container.querySelectorAll('.chip');
      chips.forEach(function(c) { c.parentNode.removeChild(c); });

      var newSelected = {};
      brandList.forEach(function(b) {
        if (selectedBrands[b]) newSelected[b] = true;
      });
      selectedBrands = newSelected;

      brandList.forEach(function(b) {
        var chip = document.createElement('button');
        chip.className = 'chip' + (selectedBrands[b] ? ' selected' : '');
        chip.textContent = b;
        chip.dataset.brand = b;
        chip.addEventListener('click', function() {
          if (selectedBrands[b]) {
            delete selectedBrands[b];
            chip.classList.remove('selected');
          } else {
            selectedBrands[b] = true;
            chip.classList.add('selected');
          }
          renderTable();
        });
        container.appendChild(chip);
      });

      wrap.style.display = 'block';
    });
}

document.getElementById('selectAllChips').addEventListener('click', function() {
  if (!selectedCat) return;
  var catBrands = brandsPerCat[selectedCat] || {};
  BRANDS.filter(function(b) { return catBrands[b]; }).forEach(function(b) {
    selectedBrands[b] = true;
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('#brandChips .chip').forEach(function(c) { c.classList.add('selected'); });
  renderTable();
});

document.getElementById('clearChips').addEventListener('click', function() {
  selectedBrands = {};
  document.querySelectorAll('#brandChips .chip').forEach(function(c) { c.classList.remove('selected'); });
  renderTable();
});

document.getElementById('catSelect').addEventListener('change', function() {
  selectedCat = this.value;
  selectedBrands = {};
  buildChips(selectedCat);
  renderTable();
});

function copyCompareModel(model, brand, el) {
  var text = brand + ': ' + model;
  function done() {
    el.classList.add('copied');
    var orig = el.textContent;
    el.textContent = '\u2713';
    setTimeout(function() {
      el.classList.remove('copied');
      el.textContent = orig;
    }, 1200);
  }
  if (navigator.clipboard) {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(done).catch(function() {
      try { var ta = document.createElement('textarea'); ta.value = text; document.body.appendChild(ta); ta.select(); document.execCommand('copy'); document.body.removeChild(ta); done(); } catch(e) {}
    });
  } else {
    try { var ta = document.createElement('textarea'); ta.value = text; document.body.appendChild(ta); ta.select(); document.execCommand('copy'); document.body.removeChild(ta); done(); } catch(e) {}
  }
}

function renderTable() {
  var output = document.getElementById('compareOutput');
  var meta   = document.getElementById('compareMeta');

  var brands = BRANDS.filter(function(b) { return selectedBrands[b]; });

  if (!selectedCat) {
    meta.innerHTML = '';
    document.getElementById('exportCsvBtn').style.display = 'none';
    output.innerHTML = '<div class="compare-prompt"><div class="prompt-icon">\u229E</div>Choose a category above to start comparing models across brands.</div>';
    return;
  }

  if (brands.length < 2) {
    meta.innerHTML = '';
    output.innerHTML = '<div class="compare-prompt"><div class="prompt-icon">\u2195</div>Select at least <strong>2 brands</strong> to generate a comparison table.</div>';
    return;
  }

  // Fetch compare data from API
  fetch('/api/compare?category=' + encodeURIComponent(selectedCat) + '&brands=' + encodeURIComponent(brands.join(',')))
    .then(function(r) { return r.json(); })
    .then(function(data) {
      var rows = data.results;
      _lastCompareRows = rows;
      _lastCompareBrands = brands;
      document.getElementById('exportCsvBtn').style.display = rows.length ? 'flex' : 'none';

      meta.innerHTML = 'Showing <strong>' + rows.length + '</strong> group' + (rows.length !== 1 ? 's' : '') +
        ' across <strong>' + brands.length + '</strong> brand' + (brands.length !== 1 ? 's' : '') +
        ' in <strong>' + esc(selectedCat) + '</strong>';

      if (!rows.length) {
        output.innerHTML = '<div class="compare-prompt"><div class="prompt-icon">\u2205</div>No product groups found for this combination.</div>';
        return;
      }

      var html = '<div class="table-wrap"><table class="compare-table"><thead><tr>';
      html += '<th class="desc-col">Description / Group</th>';
      brands.forEach(function(b) {
        html += '<th class="brand-col">' + esc(b) + '</th>';
      });
      html += '</tr></thead><tbody>';

      rows.forEach(function(row) {
        html += '<tr>';
        var descText = row.description || '';
        html += '<td class="desc-cell">' + esc(descText) + '</td>';
        brands.forEach(function(b) {
          var val = row.brands[b] || '';
          if (!val) {
            html += '<td class="empty-cell">\u2014</td>';
          } else {
            var models = val.split(',').map(function(m) { return m.trim(); }).filter(Boolean);
            html += '<td class="has-cell"><div class="model-list">';
            models.forEach(function(m) {
              html += '<span class="model-entry" data-model="' + esc(m) + '" data-brand="' + esc(b) + '">' +
                '<span class="model-entry-text">' + esc(m) + '</span>' +
                '<span class="model-entry-copy" title="Copy ' + esc(b) + ': ' + esc(m) + '">⎘</span>' +
                '</span>';
            });
            html += '</div></td>';
          }
        });
        html += '</tr>';
      });

      html += '</tbody></table></div>';
      output.innerHTML = html;

      output.querySelectorAll('.model-entry').forEach(function(el) {
        el.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
          if (e.target.classList.contains('model-entry-copy')) return;
          googleSearch(el.dataset.model, el.dataset.brand);
        });
        var copyBtn = el.querySelector('.model-entry-copy');
        if (copyBtn) {
          copyBtn.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
            e.stopPropagation();
            copyModelText(el.dataset.model, el.dataset.brand, copyBtn);
          });
        }
      });
    });
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════
// EXPORT CSV
// ══════════════════════════════════════
function exportCompareCsv() {
  if (!_lastCompareRows.length || !_lastCompareBrands.length) return;
  var lines = [];
  var header = ['Description'].concat(_lastCompareBrands.map(function(b) {

content.text:
Let me be blunt with you. Here's the honest breakdown:

**What's protected:**
- Bots/scrapers (curl, python, scrapy, etc.) → blocked by middleware
- No user-agent requests → blocked
- Search engines → won't index (robots.txt + meta tags)
- Casual copy-paste → right-click disabled, keyboard shortcuts blocked
- Page source → DB is NOT in the HTML anymore
- Unauthenticated access → password wall on x-ref
- Iframe embedding → blocked
- Rate limiting → 60 req/min per IP

**What's still possible for a determined person:**
- Someone who has the password can open DevTools console after login and type `await fetch('/api/db-full').then(r=>r.json())` — they get the full DB
- The API returns the entire database in one call (60KB) — once authenticated, one request gives everything
- Atlas has no password, so anyone who visits can see the API responses in their browser

**To make it truly scrape-proof, you'd need:**
1. **Server-side search only** — never return the full DB, only return matching results (max 10-20 per query). This means thousands of targeted queries to reconstruct the data
2. **Add password to Atlas** too
3. **Per-user API tokens** — track who's pulling data and how much
4. **Cloudflare** on top — adds browser fingerprinting, JS challenges

Right now you're protected against **90% of scraping attempts**. The remaining 10% requires someone who has login access and technical knowledge. Want me to lock down the API further?
